headline.story_zh:
这件东西解决的是所有 AI 推理游戏的通病：**模型能被说服**。你追问几轮、换个角度施压，它就开始改口——凶手是谁取决于你问得多凶，而不是案子本身。

它的做法是把答案从模型手里拿走。开局由脚本生成案件，凶手随机定死，然后**当场算一个 SHA-256 交给你**。作者管这叫 proof-of-honesty，并且要求把哈希原样展示给玩家——**你手上有凭据，模型改不了口，改了你验得出来**。模型在这局里只是舞台：你问谁，它就照那张嫌疑人卡演谁，卡上写着这人的假不在场证明、会回避什么、会撒哪个谎。它连自己在演的是不是凶手都不知道。

真正让我服气的是困难模式。它会塞进一个**指错人的第二证人**——而扮演那个证人的模型，自己也不知道那是假的。所以你没法靠察言观色，只能交叉比对不在场证明。一个把「连我自己都被蒙在鼓里」写进设计的游戏，比任何「我保证不剧透」的承诺都可靠。

它还写了一节「什么时候别用我」：多线战役、开放世界跑团、想写推理小说而不是玩、真实罪案和现实人物——一律礼貌拒绝，也不接非黑色电影的题材。**一个只做一件事、并且把不做的事列出来的小游戏。**

不适合谁：想玩长线战役的人。它就是一局 5 到 15 分钟，打完那个案子文件就结了。

item.name: noir-interrogation
item.title_zh: 用 SHA-256 锁死凶手的黑色电影审讯游戏
item.tagline_zh: 玩推理最怕 AI 中途被你说服改口。这个把答案的哈希公示在开场简报里，你一间间审嫌疑人，它只照脚本发的卡演。
item.why_zh: 困难模式会塞进一个指错人的假证人，而扮演那个嫌疑人的模型自己也不知道那是假的。
item.limit_zh: 一局 5–15 分钟，单场结束就完，不做多线战役。只有黑色电影一种类型，中途要奇幻或科幻会被拒绝；两套设定是 1940 年代美式与 1930 年代民国上海。作者明写不许 agent 去 Read 或 cat 案件 JSON，一旦绕过脚本，这个设计就作废了。
item.title_en: A noir interrogation game that hashes the killer before you start
item.tagline_en: What ruins AI mysteries is talking the model out of its own answer. Here the solution is SHA-256 committed in the opening briefing, and every suspect is played strictly off a card the script hands over.
item.why_en: Hard mode plants a second witness who names the wrong person, and the model playing that suspect is not told the statement is false either.
item.limit_en: One case runs 5–15 minutes and ends there; no campaigns. Noir only — fantasy or sci-fi requests are declined — in two settings, 1940s America and 1930s Shanghai. The file forbids the agent from ever reading or cat-ing the case JSON, since bypassing the script defeats the whole design.

headline_history.story_zh:
今天这件的招牌是一条自我约束：不调任何图像生成模型。给它一张你自己拍的照片，它用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 把画面重新画一遍，无头 Chrome 导出 PNG——成品里一个照片像素都没有。

为什么这算品味而不是自找麻烦：所有效果都来自可控的代码，所以出品是稳定的，不是抽卡抽出来的。作者把方法论写得比多数设计文档还狠——「如果观者还在数花瓣，画的就仍是物体」；采样时明令不采轮廓，因为「采了就会忍不住去画」，他还记下了实测：树梢的 141 个锯齿点，让一道横痕被画成了山。

最让我服气的是那条盲画协议。开工先自测三件事，其中一件是「你能看见渲染出来的 PNG 吗」——检验方式是渲染后用一句话说出画面里的三个东西，说不出就是看不见。看不见时强制进入盲画模式：第一版画完立刻交人，此后每一轮改动只能由用户反馈驱动，自发迭代次数为零。一个作者肯把「我的 agent 可能看不见自己画了什么」写进流程并给出降级路径，比任何效果图都更能说明他在乎。

不适合谁：本机跑不了无头 Chrome 和 PIL 的人。缺一样它就降级成交你一个 HTML 文件、颜色请你自己报，手机上基本用不了。

skills.name: visa-application
skills.title_zh: 分得清分享码有效期和签证有效期的签证材料装配台
skills.tagline_zh: 从一句「我要办日本签证」到一叠按顺序编号、能直接打印递窗口的材料：封面信、在职证明、清单和填好的表，档案存下来下次复用。
skills.tagline_en: Goes from "help me sort out my Japan visa" to a numbered, officer-ready print pack — cover letter, employment letter, filled form, checklist — and keeps a profile so the next application is a one-day job.
skills.desc_en: A Claude Code skill that takes you from 'I need a visa' to a printed, officer-ready document pack — any country, any visa.
skills.why_zh: 它列出了会读错的日期陷阱：英国分享码 30 天就过期，它证明的那个签证却能有效好几年，两个不是一回事。
skills.why_en: It lists the date traps that sink applications: a UK share code expires in 30 days while the visa it proves can be valid for years, and the two are not the same field.
skills.limit_zh: 会把护照号、工资、IBAN 存进 ~/.claude/visa-profile.json（本地明文），但写之前必须等你确认每一个字段。规则以官网为准、要求交叉核对至少两个来源，两个来源冲突它只报告分歧不替你选。每次开场都会打印一个像素 banner。
skills.limit_en: It stores passport numbers, salary and IBAN in ~/.claude/visa-profile.json in plain text locally — though it must wait for you to confirm each extracted value first. Requirements come from official sites cross-validated across at least two sources, and when sources disagree it surfaces the disagreement rather than picking. Every invocation prints a pixel-art banner first.
skills.title_en: The visa pack assembler that knows a share code is not a visa

skills.name: ai-product-video
skills.title_zh: 把你的网页做成有卡点和音效的产品宣传片
skills.tagline_zh: 先只读地看一遍产品，再给三种互不合并的模式：套模板、全自动、共同创作。152 张镜头卡都带 demo 源码。
skills.tagline_en: A read-only product inspection comes first, then three modes that never merge: template, autonomous, or co-creation. All 152 shot recipe cards ship with demo source.
skills.desc_en: A read-only product inspection comes first, then three modes that never merge: template, autonomous, or co-creation. All 152 shot recipe cards ship with demo source.
skills.why_zh: 它明说别只因为 Ink Press 是现成模板就推荐它，得给出适合与不适合的具体依据。
skills.why_en: It tells the agent not to recommend the Ink Press template just because it is ready-made, and to give concrete reasons it does or does not fit.
skills.limit_zh: 要 Remotion 工具链，成片靠真实页面截图，产品跑不起来就没素材。音效库另有 ATTRIBUTION 和试听记录，商用前自己核授权。目前只对 web 和桌面产品调过。
skills.limit_en: Needs the Remotion toolchain, and the footage comes from real page screenshots — if the product does not run, there is nothing to shoot. The SFX library carries its own ATTRIBUTION and audition log; check the licences before commercial use. Tuned for web and desktop products only so far.
skills.title_en: Your web app, cut into a promo film with beats and sound design

skills.name: as-told-to
skills.title_zh: 把父母的人生录成逐字稿，另出一份下次接着问的笔记
skills.tagline_zh: 一场一场地采访你或你父母的人生，逐字稿原样留档，另出一份下次接着问的笔记；成不成书随你，档案先归你自己。
skills.tagline_en: Interviews you, or your parent, session by session; keeps the verbatim transcript untouched and a separate working note for next time. Whether it becomes a book is your call — the archive is yours either way.
skills.desc_en: A deep life-story interviewer for Claude and Codex — your story, in your words, in plain files you own. Never invents a word of your life. Free, MIT.
skills.why_zh: 不许递一个细节让老人点头确认：「大概 2003 年冬天吧」进待核清单，正文写「我不确定」。
skills.why_en: It will not hand the elder a detail to nod at. "Probably winter 2003" goes on the verify list, and the record itself says "2003 or 2004 — I'm not certain."
skills.limit_zh: 它只采访在场的本人，不替不在场的人写传记，也拒绝改写成简历、领英简介或创始人故事。情绪一上来就全停：只给「留在这里／换话题／今天到这」三个选项，一个追问都不许有。仓库 dev/ 目录里抄了同行的整份 skill 当对照，安装时别一起拷进去。
skills.limit_en: It only interviews the person in the room, refuses to write a biography of someone absent, and declines to convert the corpus into a resume, LinkedIn bio or founder story. When emotion rises it stops entirely, offering only stay here / change the subject / done for today, with no question about what surfaced. The repo's dev/ folder contains other authors' full skills copied in as prior art — don't install that part.
skills.title_en: A verbatim transcript, plus a note on what to ask next time

skills.name: travel-guidebook
skills.title_zh: 一张 AI 插图都不许有、emoji 也禁的旅行路书
skills.tagline_zh: 把行程调研做成能打印的 PDF 路书：暖色纸底、衬线体、Tabler 图标和内联 SVG 装饰，靠排版撑设计感。
skills.tagline_en: Turns trip research into a printable PDF guidebook — warm parchment ground, serif type, Tabler icons and inline SVG ornament. The design comes from typesetting, not from generated pictures.
skills.desc_en: AI agent skill that generates beautifully typeset travel guidebook PDFs —  from research to print, powered by parallel agents and Amap MCP.
skills.why_zh: 「零 AI 插图」是硬规则不是风格偏好——旅行册子最容易骗人的就是一张不存在的风景图。
skills.why_en: Zero AI illustration is a hard rule rather than a taste preference. The easiest way for a travel book to lie is a landscape photo of a place that does not exist.
skills.limit_zh: 要 Node.js 和 Playwright 才能导 PDF，装环境有成本。深度调研阶段会并行开五个 agent，很吃 token。成品是印刷导向的长文档，不是手机上随时改的行程 App。只做排版和成书，订票订房都不管。
skills.limit_en: Needs Node.js and Playwright to export the PDF. The research stage fans out five parallel agents and burns tokens. The output is a print-oriented document, not a phone itinerary you tweak on the road. It typesets and binds; it books nothing.
skills.title_en: A travel guidebook that bans AI illustrations and emoji outright

skills.name: handdraw-skill
skills.title_zh: 拿 JSON 分镜渲一支手绘白板讲解 MP4
skills.tagline_zh: 只吃本地 SVG、不碰生视频模型：写 project.json、跑 validate、渲成带配音的成片。
skills.tagline_en: Local path-based SVG only, no text-to-video model anywhere: write project.json, run validate, render an MP4 with free Edge TTS narration.
skills.desc_en: Local path-based SVG only, no text-to-video model anywhere: write project.json, run validate, render an MP4 with free Edge TTS narration.
skills.why_zh: 它自己说清 write 只是确定性显字、不是真笔顺——不拿动效冒充手写。
skills.why_en: It says plainly that `write` is a deterministic reveal, not real stroke order — no passing an animation off as handwriting.
skills.limit_zh: 素材必须是本地 SVG 线稿，位图和外链一律不收；每场限八个物件、建议三到八秒。要 Node 和 FFmpeg，配音走 Edge TTS 需联网。没说时长就按 30 秒并把这个假设写在标题里。
skills.limit_en: Assets must be local SVG line art; raster images and remote URLs are refused. Eight objects per scene, three to eight seconds each. Needs Node and FFmpeg, and Edge TTS narration needs network. With no duration given it targets 30 seconds and states that assumption in the title.
skills.title_en: A hand-drawn whiteboard explainer MP4 from a JSON storyboard

skills.name: video-podcast-summary
skills.title_zh: 把一期播客做成带时间戳的单页 HTML
skills.tagline_zh: 核心洞察前置、目录可点、关键引述配中译、精彩对谈还原成文字，还能把片段视频嵌进去，无外部依赖。
skills.tagline_en: Core insights up front, a clickable table of contents, key quotes with translation, standout exchanges transcribed verbatim, and optional embedded clips — no external dependencies.
skills.desc_en: Core insights up front, a clickable table of contents, key quotes with translation, standout exchanges transcribed verbatim, and optional embedded clips — no external dependencies.
skills.why_zh: 第零步是给每期单独建目录——不然上一期的 clips 和 transcript 会串进这一期。
skills.why_en: Step zero is a fresh directory per video, because otherwise the previous episode's clips and transcript bleed into this one.
skills.limit_zh: 要装 yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg，长视频转写慢。产物是一页 HTML 不是可编辑源；版式跟着仓库模板走，想换风格得自己改 references/html-template.md。
skills.limit_en: Needs yt-dlp and ffmpeg, and transcription of a long video is slow. The deliverable is a finished HTML page rather than an editable source; the layout follows the bundled template, so restyling means editing references/html-template.md.
skills.title_en: One timestamped HTML page out of a two-hour podcast

skills.name: visiomaster
skills.title_zh: 截图里的架构图重画成 Visio 能拖的 vsdx
skills.tagline_zh: 截图里的流程图和论文模块图，它重建成节点、标签、连接线都能选中的 Visio 文件，再导出 SVG 和 PNG。
skills.tagline_en: Flowcharts, architecture diagrams and paper module figures come back as selectable nodes, labels and connectors through an image to scene.json to Visio COM pipeline.
skills.desc_en: 参考 ppt-master 思路构建的 Visio 图形重建工具包，将流程图、架构图和论文模块图从图片重建为可编辑 .vsdx，并导出 SVG/PNG。
skills.why_zh: 它禁止用「把原图贴上去」蒙混过关：主结构必须重画成可编辑图元，只有小缩略图和纹理允许留位图。
skills.why_en: Pasting the original image is explicitly forbidden as an answer: the main structure must be redrawn as editable shapes, and only thumbnails or textures may stay raster.
skills.limit_zh: Windows 专用，要本机装 Visio 桌面版和 pywin32，mac 和 Linux 完全跑不了。严格复核必须有本地源图文件，聊天附件不算。宽而密的图得先分区，一次画不完。
skills.limit_en: Windows only, with desktop Visio and pywin32 installed — nothing runs on macOS or Linux. Strict review requires a real local source file; a chat attachment does not count.
skills.title_en: Rebuilds a diagram screenshot as a .vsdx you can drag in Visio

skills.name: nurb
skills.title_zh: 零件参数名就是滑块名，浏览器里拖着改的 3D 打印件
skills.tagline_zh: 零件是一个 Python 函数，关键字默认值就是浏览器里的滑块。每次保存不动镜头就重建，尺寸由你拖着定。
skills.tagline_en: Every part is a Python function and its keyword defaults become labelled sliders in a live viewer that rebuilds on save without moving your camera.
skills.desc_en: Agentic CAD for 3D printing
skills.why_zh: 它把参数名当界面写：不许叫 pilot_dia，得叫 screw_hole_width——滑块只有这行字。
skills.why_en: A look is a hypothesis and a number settles it: it answers "that wall looks thin" with the measured 1.6mm against your printer's 1.0mm line width instead of agreeing.
skills.limit_zh: 要装 nurb 工具链并常驻一个 nurb dev 服务。手机扫的模型只算参考几何，配合面得先打一条试片。在架另有一件 CadQuery 建模台，两件是不同路子。
skills.limit_en: You install the nurb toolchain and keep a dev server running. Phone scans count as reference geometry, so mating surfaces need a printed fit coupon first. A CadQuery bench is already on the shelf.
skills.title_en: A printable part whose parameter names are the sliders you drag

skills.name: bili-note
skills.title_zh: 字幕太稀就不许写成完整笔记的 B 站视频提炼
skills.tagline_zh: 把 B 站视频和图文动态变成可检索的 Markdown 笔记，优先取字幕，取不到再转写音频，要评论就抓评论并滤掉闲聊。
skills.tagline_en: Turns Bilibili videos and article posts into searchable Markdown notes. Subtitles first, audio transcription as fallback, comments pulled and filtered when you want them.
skills.desc_en: Extract Bilibili videos into learning-oriented Markdown notes with full subtitle and comment archives
skills.why_zh: 它先算字幕密度：字数偏少就判定信息在画面里，标记 needs_visual_review，拒绝拿稀字幕凑整。
skills.why_en: It measures subtitle density first. When the word count is thin it concludes the content lives on screen, flags needs_visual_review, and will not pad a sparse transcript into a complete note.
skills.limit_zh: 只认 B 站。网页 AI 字幕要 Chrome 加 web-access，Edge 和临时浏览器都不等价。付费内容要你自己是登录态。转写增强要装几个 G 的 Qwen3-ASR。关键帧要模型能看图，看不了它会明说只能给有限笔记。
skills.limit_en: Bilibili only. The web AI-subtitle route needs Chrome plus web-access — Edge, a throwaway Playwright browser and a bare CDP port are explicitly not equivalent. Paid or login-gated videos need you already logged in. The transcription path pulls a multi-gigabyte Qwen3-ASR environment. Keyframe understanding needs a model that can see images; without one it says so.
skills.title_en: A Bilibili note-taker that refuses to write full notes from thin subtitles

skills.name: oil-icon
skills.title_zh: 16 枚一次生成再切开，出一套透明底的同款图标
skills.tagline_zh: 一次只生一张 4×4 灰底大图再切开——同一次生成出来的 16 枚，风格才真的一样。切完合到品红底上逐枚验边。
skills.tagline_en: Style consistency by construction: sixteen icons come out of a single generation on flat grey, then get sliced and background-removed one cell at a time.
skills.desc_en: Generate cohesive transparent-background icon sets from 4x4 image sheets
skills.why_zh: 它明说不干什么：单个图标去画 SVG，16–24px 的界面小图标去用矢量库，位图在那个尺寸不锐。
skills.why_en: The mandatory QA step composites every cut icon onto magenta and checks the edge, because a halo you cannot see on white is the thing that ruins the set.
skills.limit_zh: 要有能调的生图工具（内置 imagegen 或 Codex），都没有就得自己出 API key。抠底分 floodfill 和 rembg 两条路，玻璃和 3D 质感容易留毛边。只适合大尺寸点睛图标。
skills.limit_en: Needs a callable image generator; without one you supply an API key yourself. Cutout runs floodfill or rembg, and glossy or 3D styles keep fringing. Not for 16-24px UI glyphs.
skills.title_en: One 4x4 sheet, sixteen icons, cut out onto transparent PNGs

skills.name: science-sim-author
skills.title_zh: 把一份 SimSpec 出成能拖滑杆的离线仿真页
skills.tagline_zh: 给它一份 SimSpec，出唯一一个 index.html：画布跑仿真、滑杆调参、时序图、导 CSV，末尾附探究学案。
skills.tagline_en: Hand it a SimSpec and get back exactly one file: canvas simulation, parameter sliders, a time-series plot, CSV export, and an inquiry worksheet.
skills.desc_en: Hand it a SimSpec and get back exactly one file: canvas simulation, parameter sliders, a time-series plot, CSV export, and an inquiry worksheet.
skills.why_zh: 输出契约写死到 DOM id 一级，禁 eval 禁外链——所以那一页在教室断网也能跑。
skills.why_en: The output contract is pinned down to DOM ids, with eval and remote assets forbidden — which is why the page still runs in a classroom with no wifi.
skills.limit_zh: 只认三种渲染器：抛体轨迹、一维振子、RC 电路；SimSpec 落到别的域它直接停下来问你，不猜着画。产物永远只有一个 index.html，多文件工程别指望。
skills.limit_en: Three renderers only: projectile trajectory, 1D oscillator, RC circuit. A SimSpec outside those domains makes it stop and ask rather than guess. The deliverable is always a single index.html — never a project tree.
skills.title_en: One offline index.html that runs the simulation, sliders and all

skills.name: qiaopi
skills.title_zh: 把「今天好想你」写成一封干支落款的南洋侨批
skills.tagline_zh: 把「今天好想你」翻成南洋华侨寄回故乡的家书，抬头、起兴、嘱咐、落款按干支年排好；说话人和对象不明就先沉浸式反问一次。
skills.tagline_en: Turns "I miss you today" into a letter a Nanyang emigrant would have sent home: salutation, seasonal opening, instructions, and a sexagenary-cycle sign-off — asking one question first if it cannot place the writer and reader.
skills.desc_en: 把现代的一句话翻译成侨批体（南洋华侨家书风格）的 skill，致敬电影《给阿嬷的情书》
skills.why_zh: 落款绝不写「妾」；历史上侨批必有钱，但你没提寄钱它就不写附银那行——凭空加一句就跳戏。
skills.why_en: The sign-off may never use the self-deprecating "concubine" form. And although real qiaopi always enclosed money, it leaves that line out unless you asked for it — inventing a remittance breaks the letter.
skills.limit_zh: 只做一种语感：潮汕南洋侨批体，以电影《给阿嬷的情书》的诗化句式为骨，不是通用文言翻译器。随件是 1888–1957 年真实侨批和电影里的信，用来学句式、不是史料库。方言只作点缀，不会写成全篇潮汕话。
skills.limit_en: It does one register — Teochew/Nanyang qiaopi, built on the lyric cadence of the 2026 film Letters to Grandma — not general classical Chinese. The bundled references are real 1888-1957 letters and lines from the film, there to teach phrasing rather than to serve as an archive. Dialect appears as seasoning only; it will not write a whole letter in Teochew.
skills.title_en: Turns "I miss you today" into a letter posted home from Nanyang

skills.name: photo-tag-by-theme
skills.title_zh: 一夹一张联系印相图，回一句编号把标签写进 IPTC
skills.tagline_zh: 一夹一张联系印相图弹进 macOS 预览，你回一句「9 | h,红叶」这样的编号语法，标签就写进 IPTC 关键词。
skills.tagline_en: One folder at a time, it renders a 6x6 contact sheet into macOS Preview; you reply with a compact code like "9 | h,autumn | 6,8: +5" and the tags go straight into IPTC keywords.
skills.desc_en: 为照片库批量打**题材**标签的 Claude Code skill。通过 macOS 预览展示联系印相图（contact sheet），用户用极简的编号+字母语法回复，脚本立即把标签写入 EXIF，可被访达、预览、Lightroom、Photos.app、digiKam 等检索
skills.why_zh: 它写明拼图不许用 Read 显示——Read 看到的图只有助手看得见，用户屏幕上什么都没有。
skills.why_en: It spells out the trap: never render the contact sheet with the Read tool, because an image Read can see is an image the user cannot. It has to land in Preview.
skills.limit_zh: 只在 macOS 上跑（靠 open 弹预览、exiftool 写标），只处理 JPG。默认词表是作者自己那十五类题材，不合你的库就得先改。它只管题材这一个维度，地点标签要另找脚本。中断了要从当前那一夹重来。
skills.limit_en: macOS only — it leans on `open` for Preview and exiftool for writing — and JPG only. The default vocabulary is the author's own fifteen subject categories, so an unusual library needs editing first. It tags subject matter only; location keywords need a separate script. Interrupt it and you redo the current folder.
skills.title_en: One contact sheet, one line of codes, IPTC keywords written

skills.name: photo-skills
skills.title_zh: 一卡 RAW 筛完调完导成成片，调色参数交给模型开
skills.tagline_zh: 三百张里挑十张最耗人。它先用本机 CLIP 模型筛掉废片和连拍重复，再让多模态模型开一套 Lightroom 参数，最后交 RawTherapee 出片，素材不上传。
skills.tagline_en: Picking ten frames out of three hundred is the tedious part. A local CLIP model culls the duds and burst duplicates, a multimodal model writes Lightroom-style parameters, and RawTherapee renders the files — nothing is uploaded.
skills.desc_en: Picking ten frames out of three hundred is the tedious part. A local CLIP model culls the duds and burst duplicates, a multimodal model writes Lightroom-style parameters, and RawTherapee renders the files — nothing is uploaded.
skills.why_zh: 分工分得对：筛片交给小模型（作者标 18 倍于 ViT-L/14、Top-10 重合 8/10），像素交给真 RAW 引擎，中间那层才让模型说话。
skills.why_en: The division of labour is right: a small local model does the culling (the author claims 18x faster than ViT-L/14 with 8/10 top-10 overlap), a real RAW engine does the pixels, and the model only speaks in the layer between.
skills.limit_zh: 本机要有 rawtherapee-cli——macOS 上 Homebrew 那份可能被系统拦在启动前、退出码 133，得换官方独立 CLI。筛片模型 300MB 首次运行才下载。RAW 才有 16 bit 余量，JPG/HEIC 只有 8 bit、曝光得保守。六件里一件是三合一版，photo-previewer 作者写明只在仓内用。
skills.limit_en: Needs rawtherapee-cli locally; on macOS a Homebrew build may be blocked before startup and exit 133, so use the official standalone CLI. The 300MB screening model downloads on first run (via an hf-mirror) and exits with manual instructions in non-interactive mode. Only RAW gives the full 16-bit latitude — JPG/HEIC are 8-bit and want conservative exposure moves. Of the six skills, one is an all-in-one merge of three others and photo-previewer is marked repo-only.
skills.title_en: Culls and grades a whole card of RAW into finished JPGs

skills.name: nature-ref-verifier
skills.title_zh: 逐条核参考文献，出字段级的验证报告
skills.tagline_zh: 整篇论文的文献表丢进去，作者顺序、卷期、页码逐字段对撞多个库，按红黄绿三级列出该改哪一条。
skills.tagline_en: Drop in a whole bibliography: author order, volume, issue and page numbers get cross-checked against several databases, then graded red, amber or green.
skills.desc_en: Drop in a whole bibliography: author order, volume, issue and page numbers get cross-checked against several databases, then graded red, amber or green.
skills.why_zh: 它把 Crossref 覆盖率老实写成七成：中文期刊和 IEEE 老文献得另走 CNKI 万方。
skills.why_en: It puts Crossref coverage honestly at around 70% — Chinese journals and older IEEE entries have to go through CNKI and Wanfang instead.
skills.limit_zh: 查中文文献要另配 kimi-datasource 或 webbridge，同步 Zotero 要 zotero-mcp，缺了就只剩 Crossref 加网页兜底。它只报分歧不替你定稿。
skills.limit_en: Chinese-language lookups need kimi-datasource or webbridge configured, and Zotero sync needs zotero-mcp; without them you are left with Crossref plus a web fallback. It reports the disagreement and leaves the final call to you.
skills.title_en: Field-by-field verification report for every reference you cite

skills.name: function-testing
skills.title_zh: 从 PRD 或提交记录出一份 Excel 测试用例
skills.tagline_zh: 正向、异常、边界、状态切换、数据一致性按需勾选，出概述、功能点清单、用例三张表，通过列是下拉框。
skills.tagline_en: Happy path, failure, boundary, state transition and data consistency get picked as needed, then land in three sheets — overview, feature inventory, cases — with a pass/fail dropdown.
skills.desc_en: Happy path, failure, boundary, state transition and data consistency get picked as needed, then land in three sheets — overview, feature inventory, cases — with a pass/fail dropdown.
skills.why_zh: P0 被定死成「出错用户一定会发现、或造成线上事故」，其余一律往下压。
skills.why_en: P0 is pinned to "the user will definitely notice, or it becomes a production incident"; everything else is pushed down.
skills.limit_zh: 它的前提是开发自测、没有专职测试，所以用例数量刻意克制，要全量覆盖矩阵的别装。只出用例不跑用例，Excel 里的通过列得你自己填。
skills.limit_en: It assumes developers test their own work with no dedicated QA, so case counts are deliberately restrained — skip it if you want an exhaustive coverage matrix. It writes cases but never runs them, and the pass column is yours to fill.
skills.title_en: An Excel test-case report from a PRD or a run of commits

skills.name: image-metadata-cleaner
skills.title_zh: 出一份洗掉元数据的图片副本和核验报告
skills.tagline_zh: 发图前先把 GPS 坐标、机身序列号这类字段抹掉：只往新副本里写，原图一个字节不动。
skills.tagline_en: Strip GPS coordinates and camera serial numbers before you post: it writes separate copies and never touches a byte of the original.
skills.desc_en: Strip GPS coordinates and camera serial numbers before you post: it writes separate copies and never touches a byte of the original.
skills.why_zh: 它明写自己不干什么：不许用来抹 AI 标记、绕溯源或糊掉平台标注。
skills.why_en: It writes down what it refuses to be: not a way to hide AI authorship, defeat provenance checks, or bypass platform labels.
skills.limit_zh: 只处理你自己拥有或获授权的图。脚本会拒绝把输出路径解析到输入同一个文件，也不给 --overwrite 除非你明说。它抹的是元数据，画面内容一个像素不改。
skills.limit_en: Only for images you own or are authorised to process. The script refuses an output path that resolves to the input file, and will not take --overwrite unless you explicitly ask. It cleans metadata; the pixels are untouched.
skills.title_en: Sanitised copies of your images, plus a verification report

skills.name: guitar-coach
skills.title_zh: 每次练琴出一份计时日志，三份之后自己排出纠正练习
skills.tagline_zh: 每次练琴出一份带计时分段的 markdown 日志，攒够三份就自己找出反复出问题的地方，把它排成今天的第一个纠正练习。
skills.tagline_en: Every session writes a timed, sectioned markdown log; once three logs exist it finds the weak spot that keeps recurring and makes it the first corrective drill of the day.
skills.desc_en: A Claude Code skill to help plan and practice guitar.
skills.why_zh: 同一个 BPM 连挂三次就降一档、循环缩到 2–4 个音，要连三次干净才准上；低档没稳前绝不加量。
skills.why_en: Fail the same BPM rung three times and it drops a rung, shortens the loop to two to four notes, and demands three clean reps before you climb back — never more volume until the lower rung is stable.
skills.limit_zh: 默认把你当「重新捡起吉他的初学者」，高阶玩家得自己覆盖设定。日志、路线图、曲库都是你本地目录里的 markdown，换机器要自己搬。听录音打分那一步要跑本地 python 脚本、只吃 WAV。只覆盖吉他，不管别的乐器。
skills.limit_en: It assumes a returning beginner unless you override that. Logs, roadmaps and repertoire are plain markdown in a folder you choose, so moving machines means moving files. The listen-and-reflect scoring runs a local python script and only takes WAV. Guitar only.
skills.title_en: Three timed practice logs in, it picks today's first corrective drill

skills.name: hekouwang-yandu-deck-skill
skills.title_zh: 把一篇文章做成一屏一镜可翻页的演示网页
skills.tagline_zh: 纯 CSS 加原生 JS 不引外链，自托管思源字体子集化治首屏字重跳变，一条命令发到 CF Pages。
skills.tagline_en: Plain CSS and vanilla JS with no external links, self-hosted subsetted Source Han fonts to kill the first-paint weight jump, and one command to publish on Cloudflare Pages.
skills.desc_en: Plain CSS and vanilla JS with no external links, self-hosted subsetted Source Han fonts to kill the first-paint weight jump, and one command to publish on Cloudflare Pages.
skills.why_zh: 它专门警告别沿用仓库里的 CF token 和 database_id，否则留言会写进别人的库。
skills.why_en: It warns you specifically not to reuse the bundled CF beacon token or database_id — your traffic would report to someone else's dashboard and your comments land in their database.
skills.limit_zh: 作者说清这份是可移植副本、真身在他自己项目里，副本会过时。三套引擎两套只维护存量。要 Cloudflare 账号、要自备字体源，留言板还要 D1。视觉底子是作者品牌，得自己改。
skills.limit_en: The author states this is a portable copy while the real system lives in his own project, so the copy drifts. Two of the three engines are maintained only for legacy decks. You need a Cloudflare account, your own font sources, and D1 for the comment board. The visual base is the author's brand and needs reworking.
skills.title_en: An article, rebuilt as a one-screen-per-beat flip-through deck

skills.name: guitar
skills.title_zh: 只给和弦走向、绝不替你抄歌词的吉他谱生成器
skills.tagline_zh: 说一个歌名，它出一份坐下就能弹的谱：和弦图、带小节数的段落结构、前奏 riff 和 solo 的六线谱。
skills.tagline_en: Name a song and it produces a chart you can sit down and play: chord diagrams, an arrangement map with bar counts, tab for the intro riff and the solo, filed into your own repertoire library with an index.
skills.desc_en: A Claude Code skill that turns a song name into an advanced, playable guitar chart
skills.why_zh: 谱里只有和弦走向、不含歌词——它让你自己从有授权的来源补上，并写明这些谱不许转发。
skills.why_en: The chart carries the progression and no lyrics — it tells you to add those from a licensed source yourself, and asks you not to republish the charts.
skills.limit_zh: 冷门曲目它会标 MEDIUM/LOW 置信度，让你自己对着录音核哪几段是猜的。和弦图靠随件 python 脚本渲染成 ASCII，没有五线谱也没有音频。谱固定存到 ~/Documents/Guitar/Songs 下。它给的是「大概是这样」，不是官方谱。
skills.limit_en: For obscure songs it flags MEDIUM or LOW confidence and tells you which parts to check against the recording. Chord diagrams render as ASCII from a bundled python script; there is no staff notation and no audio. Charts always land in ~/Documents/Guitar/Songs. What you get is a careful best reading, not an official transcription.
skills.title_en: The guitar chart builder that will not type out the lyrics

skills.name: meta-analysis
skills.title_zh: 出森林图漏斗图，附一份能原样重跑的 R
skills.tagline_zh: RevMan 全套加 metareg、贝叶斯网络 Meta、TSA、诊断 Meta，每一步都交可复现 R 代码。
skills.tagline_en: RevMan's full feature set plus Stata's metareg/mvmeta, Bayesian network meta, TSA and diagnostic meta — every module ships reproducible R.
skills.desc_en: RevMan's full feature set plus Stata's metareg/mvmeta, Bayesian network meta, TSA and diagnostic meta — every module ships reproducible R.
skills.why_zh: 它从不替你装 R 包：装包是你在自己环境里的手动动作——这条堵住了静默改环境。
skills.why_en: It never installs R packages for you: installing is a manual act in your own environment, which shuts the door on silent environment changes.
skills.limit_zh: 要自己装 Rscript 和二十来个包，装不上就跑不了。为绕开市场对 .R 文件的限制，R 源码以 Python 模板存着，首次要跑 check_integrity.sh 生成。只往当前目录写产物、不外传数据。
skills.limit_en: You install Rscript and twenty-odd packages yourself; if that fails, nothing runs. To work around a marketplace restriction on .R files the R source lives as Python templates, so the first run needs check_integrity.sh. It writes only into the working directory and sends no data out.
skills.title_en: Forest and funnel plots, plus the R code to reproduce them

skills.name: compose-this-scene
skills.title_zh: 一张照片切出五种构图预览，附标注和联系表
skills.tagline_zh: 它不停在「主体偏左」这种话上：每个方向给一个归一化裁剪框，脚本渲成裁剪图、压暗标注图和一张联系表。
skills.tagline_en: It commits to normalized crop boxes and focus points, then renders each one as a preview, a dimmed annotated original, and one contact sheet to compare across.
skills.desc_en: 一个摄影构图技能。分析任意照片，提出 3–5 种不同构图方向，并生成可视化的裁剪预览和标注图。
skills.why_zh: 三到五个方向必须意图不同——不是同一张图裁大裁小，负空间、引导线、极近特写各占一个。
skills.why_en: The options must differ in intent rather than in tightness: negative space, leading-line geometry and a dramatic close crop each have to earn their own slot.
skills.limit_zh: 要有本地图片路径才渲得出图，聊天里的附件只能给文字建议。脚本只做裁剪和参考线叠加，不修色不修图。参考里的摄影师名字是风格坐标，不是能套的预设。
skills.limit_en: Rendering needs a local file path; a chat attachment only gets you words. The script crops and overlays guides — it does not grade or retouch. Photographer names are references, not presets.
skills.title_en: Five crops of the same photo, rendered with guides and a contact sheet

skills.name: photography-coach
skills.title_zh: 修图步骤写成界面路径、控件、起始值和看什么算对
skills.tagline_zh: 丢一张参考图或自己拍砸的片子，它先分开「读到的元数据」和「看出来的推测」，再问你用哪个 app 修图。
skills.tagline_en: Hand it a reference shot or a photo that came out weak; it separates what it actually read from metadata from what it is only inferring, then asks whether you edit in Apple Photos or Lightroom before naming a single slider.
skills.desc_en: Multilingual Codex skill for photo analysis, EXIF/GPS-aware guidance, style matching, shooting plans, and app-specific editing steps.
skills.why_zh: 不问你用哪个 app 就不给步骤，那个工具里没有的控件也不许开——读到的元数据和看出来的推测分开写。
skills.why_en: It won't name a slider before you say whether you edit in Apple Photos or Lightroom, and it may never prescribe a control the chosen tool does not have.
skills.limit_zh: 它只给方向和起始值，不替你出图。GPS 默认只说到区域或地标一级，要精确坐标得你自己开口。截图和社交平台下载图它拒绝推断 EXIF。风格库里列的是摄影师和奖项的名字，不是能直接套的滤镜。
skills.limit_en: It gives directions and starting values, never a finished file. GPS stays at area or landmark level unless you ask for precision. It refuses to infer EXIF from screenshots or social-media downloads. Its style library names photographers and awards as references, not as filters you can apply.
skills.title_en: Edit steps as screen path, control, starting value, and what to look for

skills.name: parametric-3d-printing
skills.title_zh: 动一行几何代码之前先去查真实尺寸的建模台
skills.tagline_zh: 用 CadQuery 分三阶段建模，每阶段渲图给你看、等你反馈再往下，最后出 STL 和打印参数建议。
skills.tagline_en: Builds parametric CadQuery models in three phases, rendering a preview and waiting for your feedback at each one, and finishes with an STL plus print recommendations.
skills.desc_en: Claude Code skill for parametric 3D-printable model generation with CadQuery
skills.why_zh: 接现实产品的尺寸一律去查、交叉两个来源：差一两毫米，这个零件就废了。
skills.why_en: For anything that has to fit a real product it searches for the spec and cross-references two sources, because even 1-2mm off makes the part unusable. And it refuses to disappear and come back with a finished model.
skills.limit_zh: CadQuery 只支持 Python 3.10–3.12，OCC 内核装不上得改走 conda；面向 FDM 功能件，不做渲染、雕刻和游戏资产，也不改你手里已有的 STL。
skills.limit_en: CadQuery needs Python 3.10-3.12; if the OCC kernel won't build you're on conda. Aimed at functional FDM parts — not rendering, sculpting, game assets, or editing an STL you already have.
skills.title_en: It searches for real dimensions before writing a line of geometry

skills.name: sticker-puzzle-memory-card
skills.title_zh: 植被多就换品红键色，把照片做成能剪下来的贴纸页
skills.tagline_zh: 照片做成好看的图不难，难的是拿到一张真能打印、真能剪的透明贴纸。它一次交记忆卡和六枚图案的透明 PNG。
skills.tagline_en: Turning a photo into a pretty image is easy; getting a transparent sheet you can actually print and cut is not. This delivers a memory card and a six-motif transparent PNG together.
skills.desc_en: 将照片转化为水粉剪纸风格旅行记忆卡 + 拼图对比图
skills.why_zh: 去背走色度键，绿场景会撞色，所以植被多的图改用品红打底，最后还要验四角 alpha 是不是 0。
skills.why_en: Background removal runs on a chroma key, and green collides with foliage, so leafy photos are keyed on magenta instead — then all four corner alphas are verified as zero.
skills.limit_zh: 生图模型被写死成 seedream_5.0_pro，接不上这个模型的 agent 装了没用。贴纸恰好六枚、手写关键词恰好三个，都是定死的，不接受你要八枚。原图里的文字只在真的标识了地点时才留，广告、菜单、价格、时间戳一律剔掉。 上游 SKILL.md 的 name 是中文，装上后可能不被识别，改成英文更稳。
skills.limit_en: The image model is hard-wired to one specific generator, so it is dead weight on an agent that cannot reach it. Six stickers and three handwritten keywords are fixed counts; asking for eight is not an option. Text from your photo survives only when it genuinely names a place — ads, menus, prices and timestamps are all stripped. Upstream's name field is Chinese, so the loader may not pick it up — rename it to ASCII.
skills.title_en: Switches the chroma key to magenta when the photo is full of green

skills.name: seedance-2-5-video-director
skills.title_zh: 把想法写成即梦 Seedance 2.5 提示词，绝不替你按生成键
skills.tagline_zh: 即梦每生成一版都在扣积分，改一次就是一次赌。它只交可复制的提示词，遇到「向前续写」这种歧义必须先问你放在原片前还是后。
skills.tagline_en: Every Dreamina render costs credits, so a vague prompt is a paid mistake. It hands you the director's brief and a copy-ready prompt, and never guesses.
skills.desc_en: Design, derive, optimize, diagnose, and rewrite scripts or copy-ready prompts specifically for Dreamina/即梦 Seedance 2.5. Use for new text/image/video/audio-to-video concepts, exact-timeline videos, 30-180-second Long Video, extension, video editing, Clay Renderer, seamless transitions, multi-grid storyboards, realistic acted dialogue, relationship drama, sports or variety-show live camera grammar,
skills.why_zh: 它把边界写成硬规则：只产文字、不调用生成、不花积分；时间戳必须严丝合缝铺满时长，眼泪和脸红不许出现在触发之前。
skills.why_en: The boundaries are hard rules: text only, no job submission, no credits spent. Timestamps must tile the full duration exactly, and a reaction may not land before its cause.
skills.limit_zh: 它不生成视频，只交提示词——粘回即梦、扣积分、返工仍是你的事。绑死 Seedance 2.5 一个模型，正文明写别把这些语法当成其他视频模型的通用规则。默认中文输出；每个新会话第一次调用会先塞一整段强制教学。
skills.limit_en: It writes prompts, not videos — pasting, paying and re-rolling stay with you. Bound to Seedance 2.5, it says not to treat its syntax as universal across video models. Output defaults to Chinese, and each session's first call opens with a tutorial.
skills.title_en: Writes your Seedance 2.5 prompt, then refuses to hit generate

skills.name: whiteboard-video
skills.title_zh: 线稿只准本地模型抽、不许 AI 生成的白板手绘视频
skills.tagline_zh: 上传一张照片，它先用本地神经网络抽出线稿，再一笔一笔画出来、配一只跟着笔尖走的手。
skills.tagline_en: Hand it a photo and it pulls the line art with a local neural model, then draws it stroke by stroke with a hand trailing the pen tip — instead of asking an image model for something that merely looks hand-drawn.
skills.why_zh: 两个本地模型一个都没装时，它规定必须直接失败 —— 不许用边缘检测糊一版弱线稿交差。
skills.why_en: With neither local model installed it is required to fail outright — no edge-detection fallback, because a weak outline that looks finished is worse than an error.
skills.limit_zh: 它只是适配层：引擎要 pip 装另一个仓库，Informative Drawings 或 Anime2Sketch 至少装一个并设环境变量，而模型的安装指南在引擎仓库里、不在这一件。一个都没装时它直接失败，不给降级方案。
skills.limit_en: It is only an adapter. The engine is a separate pip install, you must set up Informative Drawings or Anime2Sketch yourself and point env vars at it, and the model setup guide lives in the engine repo rather than here. With neither installed, extract-lineart and render-photo fail outright.
skills.title_en: Refuses to let an image model draw the line art

skills.name: boardgame-creator
skills.title_zh: 把点子做成今天就能手写出来的纸面原型和试玩问题
skills.tagline_zh: 点子有了，卡在「到底好不好玩」。它先把 6–10 个关键决策一次交底，再逼出一份今天就能手写出来的纸面原型。
skills.tagline_en: You have the idea and you are stuck on whether it actually plays. This states the six to ten decisions that matter up front, then drives you to a paper prototype you could hand-write today.
skills.desc_en: 中文实体桌游创作 Skill：从灵感、纸面原型到试玩迭代与朋友介绍材料
skills.why_zh: 它给自己上了禁令：没经过真人试玩只能说「可试玩」，不能说「平衡」——纸面审查只找风险，不发合格证。
skills.why_en: It bans itself from certain words: with no real playtest it may only say "playable", never "balanced". Paper review finds risks; it does not issue a pass.
skills.limit_zh: 平衡只能靠真人试玩验，所以你得自己凑齐人——它明写纸面审查不能证明平衡。交付物是纸面原型，美术、量产、众筹一概不管，第一版明说不追求出版。多视角批评里连「易感到被针对者」都算上了，但那仍是模拟，不是玩家。不做电子游戏实现。
skills.limit_en: Balance can only be proven at a real table, so you have to find the players yourself; the file says outright that paper review cannot prove balance. What you get is a paper prototype — art, manufacturing and crowdfunding are all out, and the first version deliberately does not aim at publication. Its multi-perspective critique even includes the player who feels picked on, but that is still simulation, not a playtester. No digital implementation.
skills.title_en: A paper prototype you could hand-write today, and what to watch in playtest

skills.name: pet-nutritionist
skills.title_zh: 严禁给龙猫洗澡、也给矮脚马算食谱的宠物营养师
skills.tagline_zh: 兔子龙猫严禁水洗、只能沙浴，豚鼠每天得补维生素C，矮脚马每 6–8 周修一次蹄——猫狗之外那些宠物，它才是主场。
skills.tagline_en: Rabbits and chinchillas must never get wet, only sand baths. Guinea pigs need vitamin C daily. A Shetland pony needs its hooves trimmed every six to eight weeks. This one lives outside the cat-and-dog world.
skills.desc_en: 科学铲屎官 - 营养×洗护×零食玩具 | Scientific Pet Care Assistant | TRAE SOLO Skill
skills.why_zh: 它先查物种合法性：蛇、土拨鼠、狐狸一律不服务，理由是《野生动物保护法》，不是不会答。
skills.why_en: It screens the species before anything else — snakes, marmots and foxes get turned away on wildlife-law grounds, not for lack of an answer.
skills.limit_zh: 皮肤问题它一律当病症处理，直接让你去医院，不给洗护调理方案。全部本事是一段提示词加十份参考清单，不带脚本也不带计算器；喂食量要你自己报品种、月龄、体重、体况和绝育状况才算。爬行类和野生动物直接拒答。
skills.limit_en: Skin trouble is always treated as illness and sent to a vet, so there is no home-grooming fix here. The whole thing is one prompt plus ten reference sheets, with no scripts and no calculator, and it will not size a meal until you supply breed, age in months, weight, body condition and neuter status. Reptiles and wild animals are refused outright.
skills.title_en: A pet nutritionist that forbids bathing your chinchilla

skills.name: trip-map-builder
skills.title_zh: 会替你删掉一半心愿单的行程地图生成器
skills.tagline_zh: 把零散截图和收藏整理成一天一片区的行程，查完点评和小红书，输出可点导航的单页交互地图。
skills.tagline_en: Turns scattered screenshots and saved links into one-neighbourhood-per-day plans, checks dining signals, and ships a single-file interactive map with navigation and reservation buttons.
skills.desc_en: 旅行行程规划技能：规划 → 小红书调研 → 交互式地图页面 | Agent Skill for trip planning with 小红书 research and interactive map generation
skills.why_zh: 它认为你列的东西塞不进去，所以替你删；一天最多安排一个需要订位的地方。
skills.why_en: It states plainly that not everything you listed fits, and deletes for you — one area per day, at most one reservation-required stop per day, and never bend a day around a famous restaurant that's off-route.
skills.limit_zh: 调研环节绑死大众点评和小红书，非中文目的地信号很弱；要装第三方 OpenCLI 并自己开带调试端口的 Chrome；产出的地图是一份静态快照，行程当天不会自己更新。 小红书那段是在你自己开的 Chrome 里拦站内搜索接口取数，账号风险你自己担。
skills.limit_en: Research is wired to Dianping and Xiaohongshu, so non-Chinese destinations get thin signal. Needs the third-party OpenCLI plus a Chrome you launch with a debug port. The map is a static snapshot, not live. The Xiaohongshu step intercepts the site's own search API inside the Chrome you launched — the account risk is yours.
skills.title_en: The itinerary that deletes half your wishlist for you

skills.name: cook-with-what-you-have
skills.title_zh: 照冰箱剩货挑出三道菜，凑不满也不放宽过敏原
skills.tagline_zh: 报一下冰箱里剩什么，它挑三道可解释的候选，原菜谱一字不改地端出来，缺什么料另写在原文之外。
skills.tagline_en: Tell it what is left in the fridge and it picks three explainable candidates from HowToCook, serving the original recipe text unchanged with the match notes and shopping gaps kept outside it.
skills.desc_en: 根据现有食材、饮食约束和厨具，从 HowToCook 推荐可解释菜谱的本地优先 Agent Skill
skills.why_zh: 原菜谱一字不改地端出来，缺料另写在原文之外——它绝不把 AI 编的菜伪装成 HowToCook 原文。
skills.why_en: The original recipe text comes out untouched, with match notes and shopping gaps kept outside it — it never passes AI-written food off as a HowToCook recipe.
skills.limit_zh: 菜谱库是打包进来的 HowToCook 离线快照，不联网，时间一长就旧，而且原仓库图片没打包、失效的相对链接一律不渲染。它明写「绝不把 AI 生成内容伪装成 HowToCook 原文」——想要 AI 自创菜的人装错了。过敏和忌口是硬过滤，凑不满三个也不放宽。
skills.limit_en: The recipe library is a bundled offline snapshot of HowToCook with no network access, so it ages, and the upstream images are not packaged — broken relative links simply are not rendered. It states outright that AI-written content must never be passed off as HowToCook original text, so anyone wanting invented dishes installed the wrong thing. Allergens and hard restrictions are never relaxed to fill out three options.
skills.title_en: Three dishes from what's in the fridge — or two, if allergens say two

skills.name: zhuanye-rensheng-tiyan
skills.title_zh: 十分钟活完计算机专业，带走一份该问真程序员的清单
skills.tagline_zh: 十分钟纯选项文字游戏，替高考生把计算机专业从大一活到 35 岁。出身在前两幕起作用，第三幕不再让它继续拉大差距。
skills.tagline_en: A ten-minute all-choices text game that walks a high-school senior through a computer science degree from freshman year to thirty-five. Background shapes the first two acts and stops widening the gap in the third.
skills.desc_en: 人生重开·选专业版 — 让高考生提前"活一遍"某专业毕业后人生的 AI 文字游戏 Skill
skills.why_zh: 禁止给薪资均值，只说「分两拨人」；铁律写着「诚实是承认牌不一样，羞辱是暗示输牌的人不配」。
skills.why_en: No average salaries allowed — only "two groups of people". Its rule reads: honesty is admitting the hands differ; humiliation is implying whoever lost deserved to.
skills.limit_zh: v1 只有计算机一个专业，别的专业玩不了。正文自认「真实性此刻靠模型的行业知识加铁律兜底，还没有查证内容包」，并明说不要宣称数据权威。出身设定刻意不问性别，理由是评审认定那一项最容易翻车。
skills.limit_en: Version one covers computer science only; no other major is playable. The file admits its realism currently rests on the model's industry knowledge plus its own guardrails, with no verified content pack yet, and says not to claim the numbers are authoritative. It also deliberately never asks your gender, because reviewers judged that variable the easiest one to get wrong.
skills.title_en: Live a CS degree in ten minutes, leave with questions for a real engineer

skills.name: bluey-parenting
skills.title_zh: 先让你冷水冲手腕 10 秒，再翻《布鲁伊》第几集
skills.tagline_zh: 「我又吼了他」——这时它不讲道理，先给一个 30 秒能做完的动作，再翻出班迪特也敷衍过孩子的那一集，标上季集号。
skills.tagline_en: "I yelled at him again." At that point it skips the reasoning, gives you one thing you can do in thirty seconds, then pulls up the episode where Bandit also fobbed his kids off — with the season and number.
skills.desc_en: 布鲁伊父母支持 - 基于Bluey动画片的育儿支持Coze技能
skills.why_zh: 四种入口走四条路：要点子的那一路明写「不先共情，直接给游戏」，五分钟能准备好。
skills.why_en: Four entry points, four different routes. The one for parents who just want an idea says outright: skip the empathy, hand over the game, five minutes of prep.
skills.limit_zh: 它的主要语料是一部动画片——没看过《布鲁伊》的人，剧集对照那一半是空的。心理学补位只在 P.E.T.、依恋理论、Gottman 等七个框架里选，必须写出提出者，「心理学研究表明」这种说法被禁掉了。剧集链接指向 B 站正版，要能访问才用得上。
skills.limit_en: Its main corpus is a cartoon, so half of it is empty if you have never watched Bluey. Psychology only fills gaps from seven named frameworks — P.E.T., attachment theory, Gottman and others — and must name whoever proposed it, with vague phrasing like "studies show" banned outright. Episode links point to the licensed Bilibili stream, which you need to be able to reach.
skills.title_en: Cold water on your wrists for ten seconds, then which Bluey episode

skills.name: money-find
skills.title_zh: 从招聘和采购信号反推出一份带推理链的副业清单
skills.tagline_zh: 只看招聘、采购、政策这类利益中立的需求信号反推机会，每条再过一遍反诈和时效两道 rubric。
skills.tagline_en: Works backwards from interest-neutral demand signals — job postings, procurement, policy — into things you could actually supply, then runs every candidate through an anti-scam and a freshness rubric.
skills.desc_en: AI 时代靠谱兼职发现 + 反诈验证 skill：需求信号反推 + 实时时效核查 + 反诈 rubric + 个性化校准环
skills.why_zh: 它拒绝把「教你赚钱」的帖子当依据：没人会把真能赚钱的方法发进那种帖，那是卖课钓粉漏斗。
skills.why_en: Its founding claim: nobody posts a method that actually makes money into a "how to get rich" thread — that content is a course-selling funnel, so it isn't a source.
skills.limit_zh: 六个 money-* 子命令是一条流水线，要整仓安装并先跑 money-init 建画像；闲鱼和 BOSS 的一手数据靠你自己开 Chrome 登录、滑块自己过；找不到靠谱机会时它就直说没找到。
skills.limit_en: Six money-* commands form one pipeline; install the whole repo and run money-init first. First-party marketplace and hiring data comes from a Chrome you log into and clear sliders in yourself. When it finds nothing credible, it says so.
skills.title_en: Works backward from job posts and procurement into things you could sell

skills.name: backend-agent-project-selector
skills.title_zh: 不许把「建议改造」写成「已完成」的简历项目侦察兵
skills.tagline_zh: 它不替你写简历。它从 GitHub 挑一个你真该动手改的业务系统，clone 到本地读源码，再告诉你哪几条能写进简历。
skills.tagline_en: It does not write your resume. It goes out to GitHub, finds one complete business system worth your actually modifying, clones it locally to read the source, then tells you which bullets you can already claim and which you have to build first.
skills.desc_en: 一个Skill，主要目标是为后端和 AI Agent 求职者，从 GitHub 里筛出真正能写进简历、能经得起面试追问的项目，并基于源码证据生成简历项目包
skills.why_zh: star 过 1k 就不再因更高而加分；本地 clone 不成功、源码里抠不出 5 个证据点的一律淘汰。
skills.why_en: Past a thousand stars, more stars earn nothing extra. Any candidate it cannot clone locally, or from whose source it cannot extract five concrete evidence points, is eliminated outright.
skills.limit_zh: 只服务后端（Java/Spring、分布式）和业务型 AI Agent 两个方向，默认排除 IoT 与嵌入式；前端、算法、非技术岗用不上。它交的不是文档而是工程作业——推荐的项目你得真去改，是几周的活。必须联网、必须 git clone，你不先选一种推荐模式它就不动。
skills.limit_en: Scoped to backend work (Java/Spring, distributed systems) and business-grade AI agents, with IoT and embedded excluded by default — no use for frontend, algorithms or non-technical roles. What it delivers is homework, not a document: the project it picks is weeks of real work. It needs the network, needs git clone, and refuses to start until you pick one of its recommendation modes.
skills.title_en: The resume project scout that will not let a plan be written up as done

skills.name: csp
skills.title_zh: 只写「她会怎么反应」不抄台词的角色蒸馏器
skills.tagline_zh: 本地脚本检索萌娘百科等站点，五路并行调研，交叉验证后蒸出三到七条可执行的行为规则。
skills.tagline_en: Runs local scripted retrieval over character wikis, five parallel research agents, cross-validates every load-bearing claim, then distils three to seven executable behaviour rules.
skills.desc_en: Character Skill Producer — distill anime characters into executable agent skills
skills.why_zh: 它抓的是她怎么行动，不是她说过什么：标签给人看，行为规则给 AI 执行。
skills.why_en: The stated distinction: capture HOW she behaves, not WHAT she said — tags are for humans, behaviour rules are for the agent to run. Anything it can't ground stays a declared boundary.
skills.limit_zh: 要 Python，且默认只跑最高保真模式，很费 token；来源黑名单排除知乎、公众号和百度百科；生成的角色包会写死资料截止日期，作品一出新剧情就得重跑。
skills.limit_en: Needs Python and runs highest-fidelity mode only, which burns tokens. Zhihu, WeChat articles and Baidu Baike are blacklisted as sources. Every generated pack stamps a data cutoff date and needs a rerun when the work updates.
skills.title_en: It writes how she behaves, not what she said

skills.name: gaokao-advisor
skills.title_zh: 按经济下行期算账、和招生办天然对立的志愿顾问
skills.tagline_zh: 市面上都是算分匹配器，它做没人碰的那部分调查：这校给分压不压、导师有没有 PUA、分配看不看关系、进去每天过什么样
skills.tagline_en: The market is full of score matchers. This one does the part nobody touches: does this school mark you down, do the supervisors bully, are placements decided by connections, what does a day there actually feel like.
skills.desc_en: 站在孩子和家长一边的高考志愿决策 Agent Skill
skills.why_zh: 一条元铁律焊死：不裁决只呈现，措辞里出现「一票否决」「完美契合」「量身定制」就自己改掉。
skills.why_en: One overriding rule: present, never adjudicate. Phrasing like "ruled out", "perfect fit" or "tailored for you" gets rewritten by the skill itself.
skills.limit_zh: 它带一整份「功利现实手册」，会把女孩选专业的婚恋算计照实端给家长，并明说不做道德评判——受不了这套的别装。志愿表要填到该省志愿数的七成以上，位次、名额、就业数字全靠现场联网核，查不到就标「待核」，不靠记忆答。
skills.limit_en: It carries a whole cynical-realities handbook and will hand parents the marriage-market arithmetic behind a daughter's choice of major, stating plainly that it passes no moral judgement — if that turns your stomach, do not install it. The list has to be filled to at least seventy percent of your province's slots, and every rank, quota and employment figure is verified live or marked unconfirmed rather than answered from memory.
skills.title_en: College-application advice priced for a downturn, structurally against the admissions office

skills.name: apple-health-analyst
skills.title_zh: 故意把综合健康分留成空值的健康报告
skills.tagline_zh: 本地解析 Apple 健康导出，出一份健康报告和一份训练报告，每条结论都必须引到具体数值或日期。
skills.tagline_en: Parses your Apple Health export locally into structured insights, then writes two cross-linked HTML reports — health and training — where every conclusion has to cite a real number or date.
skills.desc_en: Privacy-conscious Apple Health export analyzer with bilingual health and multi-sport training reports
skills.why_zh: 复合评分字段一律留 null：不许用消费级设备的杂糅指标编一个健康总分。
skills.why_en: compositeAssessment stays null on purpose: do not invent a single health score out of heterogeneous consumer-device metrics, and don't pretend to be a coach writing a periodised plan.
skills.limit_zh: 要你自己从 iPhone 导出 zip 并装它的 npx 包；明确不做诊断、不推药物治疗或补剂剂量；睡眠分期、血氧、VO2max 一律当估计值；只有健康与训练两份报告，没有饮食营养。
skills.limit_en: You export the zip from your iPhone and install its npx package. It explicitly won't diagnose, name a condition, or recommend medication, treatment or supplement doses. Sleep stages, SpO2 and VO2max are treated as estimates. No nutrition.
skills.title_en: The health report that leaves the composite score deliberately null

skills.name: professor-skill
skills.title_zh: 把「这题上课讲过」蒸成一份期末自救包
skills.tagline_zh: 课件、真题、群里问答分两条线走：一条抽考试范围和给分偏好，一条抽这位老师的说话方式。
skills.tagline_en: Splits your course materials into two engines — a Course Brain for exam scope, question patterns and grading preferences, and a Teacher Persona for how this specific lecturer actually talks.
skills.desc_en: 把不会划重点的老师，蒸馏成会救你期末的 Skill. Distill course materials into professor-style review, question patterns, and grading hints.
skills.why_zh: 分工写得很清楚：人格决定语气，课程大脑决定内容；玩笑只能来自认得出，不能是随口段子。
skills.why_en: The division of labour is explicit: persona decides tone, Course Brain decides substance. And humour must come from recognition, never from random jokes.
skills.limit_zh: 要你自己手里有课件和真题，材料薄它会明说置信度低；老师是真人，导入私聊记录和课堂录音你未必有权；它禁止把生成内容说成老师的正式通知或评分规则。
skills.limit_en: You need real materials; thin input gets an honest low-confidence label. Your professor is a real person, and you may not have the right to ingest private chat logs or recordings. It refuses to pass output off as official notices or grading rules.
skills.title_en: Distils 'we covered this in class' into an exam rescue kit

skills.name: anki
skills.title_zh: 你不点头一张都不写进 Anki 的闪卡生成器
skills.tagline_zh: 把你在学的东西变成卡片写进 Anki 牌组。挖空有一档只露形状不露字：光速那串数字有几位看得见，数字本身看不见。
skills.tagline_en: Turns whatever you are studying into cards and writes them straight into a deck over AnkiConnect. Cloze has a mode that shows shape but not text — you can see how many digits the speed of light has, without seeing the digits.
skills.desc_en: Anki add-on for Markdown notes with syntax highlighting powered by Shiki
skills.why_zh: 「加卡前先把卡全摊给你看，等你说 yes」被写成不可协商——这正是 AI 批量造卡最容易糊过去的一步。
skills.why_en: "Never add cards without explicit user approval" is written as non-negotiable, with every proposed card shown in full first — exactly the step bulk card generation usually skips.
skills.limit_zh: 得先装 Anki 桌面版、开 AnkiConnect，还得装这个仓库自带的 Anki Markdown 笔记类型——三样缺一样就跑不起来。删卡、改卡、评分各要单独确认一次。示例几乎全是代码和技术词，拿来学语言得自己重写卡面规范。
skills.limit_en: You need Anki desktop running, AnkiConnect enabled, and the repo's own Anki Markdown note type installed; miss one and nothing works. Delete, update and rate each ask for their own confirmation. The examples lean almost entirely on code and technical terms, so language learners will want to rewrite the card conventions.
skills.title_en: Writes nothing into Anki until you say yes

skills.name: xianyu-monitor
skills.title_zh: 盯闲鱼上新出一份跨轮去重的清单，成色一律标未知
skills.tagline_zh: 关键词、价格、地区筛完自动去重，最短半小时一轮盯上新，成色和信誉一律标成未知，不替你猜。
skills.tagline_en: Recurring keyword searches on China's biggest used-goods market, with price and region filters, dedup across runs, and a hard 30-minute floor on polling.
skills.desc_en: Cross-host Agent Skill for Xianyu/Goofish (闲鱼) listing search and monitoring: keyword, price/location filters, pagination, deduplication, and persistent tasks.
skills.why_zh: 撞上滑块就停手、不换身份、不重复硬试，也绝不替你出价——同类爬虫都在装成人类。
skills.why_en: Its own rule: stop at the risk-control gate, don't bypass it, don't rotate identity — and never bid for you. Every comparable scraper is busy pretending to be human.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖闲鱼一家。要在它单独开的浏览器里手动扫码登录，滑块也得你自己过；轮询最短 30 分钟，秒杀捡漏用不上；它不发消息、不下单、不付款。
skills.limit_en: Xianyu/Goofish only. You log in yourself in a dedicated Playwright window and clear any slider by hand; 30-minute minimum interval rules out flash-deal sniping; it never messages, bids, or pays.
skills.title_en: A deduped list of new Xianyu listings, with condition left "unknown"

skills.name: legal-language-bridge
skills.title_zh: 把「定金」和「订金」两个字掰开算钱的维权翻译机
skills.tagline_zh: 你说「公司无故辞退我」，它输出能提交的仲裁申诉文本，附证据清单、维权路径和赔偿估算。覆盖劳动、租房、预付卡等 15 类。
skills.tagline_en: Say "my company fired me for no reason" and it hands back a filable arbitration statement, plus the evidence you need to keep, the route to take, and a compensation range. Fifteen domains, from labour to tenancy to prepaid cards that vanished.
skills.desc_en: 将普通人日常表达转化为专业法律语言，使生成的内容可直接用于法律文书、劳动仲裁申请、消费投诉、对外交涉等场景。同时提供反向翻译功能，将法律文书中的法言法语解读为通俗易懂的大白话。  本版本新增： 四个新场景（医疗/教培/保险/预付卡）、维权路径地图、证据清单、赔偿计算器、常见误区纠正、合同条款逐条解读、判决书摘要、双模式翻译引擎。  核心理念： 本 Skill 不是法律咨询工具，不替代律师。它帮助用
skills.why_zh: 误区表逐条对撞常识：定金不退订金可退，食品假货是退一赔十，2N 和 N 不能同时主张。
skills.why_en: Its misconception table collides with common sense line by line: one kind of deposit is forfeit and the other refundable, counterfeit food pays ten times over, and you cannot claim both severance and the double-damages figure.
skills.limit_zh: 中国大陆法律，条文和赔偿标准会随司法解释变动，正文明写不构成法律意见、不替代律师。赔偿计算器只给区间，各省的一次性伤残就业补助金标准要你自己查。合同逐条解读这一块和在架的 AnythingButLaw 有重叠。
skills.limit_en: Mainland Chinese law only, and the statutes and compensation standards shift with judicial interpretation — the skill states outright that it is not legal advice and no substitute for a lawyer. The calculator gives ranges; province-specific disability employment subsidies you look up yourself. Its clause-by-clause contract reading overlaps with AnythingButLaw, already on the shelf.
skills.title_en: The grievance translator that pries apart two nearly identical Chinese words for deposit

skills.name: huashu-slide-doubao
skills.title_zh: 用豆包自带生图出整套 PPT，一分第三方 API 钱不花
skills.tagline_zh: 做课件、公众号头图、B站封面都得掏生图 API 的钱。它把这步锁死在豆包内置 seedream 上，还给封面、扉页、内容页、结论页各配一条密度上限。
skills.tagline_en: Course decks, WeChat headers and Bilibili thumbnails all bill you per generated image. This one pins that step to Doubao's built-in seedream, and gives covers, section breaks, content pages and closers four separate density ceilings.
skills.desc_en: 豆包环境专用的视觉物料生产：PPT / Keynote / HTML deck、公众号封面与正文配图、B站/YouTube 视频封面。存在的全部理由是走豆包内置 image_gen（默认 seedream_5.0_pro 模型），不花第三方图像 API 的钱——不在豆包环境就别用。用户说做PPT、幻灯片、演示文稿、deck、公众号封面、视频封面时触发。
skills.why_zh: 它给字数上限配了反向约束：正文明写「AI 看到 220 字上限就会朝 220 字写」，于是先逼你答这页要人记住哪一句。
skills.why_en: The word ceiling comes with a counterweight: the text warns that a model told "220 characters max" will write to 220, so every page must first name the one line the audience should remember.
skills.limit_zh: 不在豆包环境就别装——作者写明它「存在的全部理由」就是豆包自带的 image_gen，默认的 seedream_5.0_pro 还是会员专属，非会员回退 4.5。产物默认是图片式 PPT，文字不可编辑，除非你明说要可编辑、或生图连挂三次。
skills.limit_en: Don't install this outside Doubao — the author calls the built-in image_gen its entire reason to exist, and the default seedream_5.0_pro is members-only, falling back to 4.5 for everyone else. Slides come out as flat images with no editable text unless you explicitly ask for editable output, or generation fails three times.
skills.title_en: Whole decks from Doubao's built-in image model, with no image API bill

skills.name: astrology
skills.title_zh: 本地星历实算西洋·印度·八字三盘
skills.tagline_zh: 西洋、印度、八字三套盘都由本地引擎实算，再按古典规则解读；三套说法一致的地方才当结论，绝不凭记忆报行星位置。
skills.tagline_en: Western, Vedic and BaZi charts computed from a local ephemeris, then read by classical rules — agreement across traditions is the strongest signal; no invented positions.
skills.desc_en: Astrology MCP server & Agent Skill — birth charts, transits, synastry across Western, Vedic/Jyotish & Chinese BaZi. Deterministic zero-dependency Python engine. 18 MCP tools, 31 REST endpoints, ChatGP
skills.why_zh: 底线只有一条：引擎算天空，模型只负责读。和会胡编行星位置的聊天机器人不是一类东西。
skills.why_en: One rule: the engine computes the sky, the model only reads. Gambling questions are refused outright.
skills.limit_zh: 解读是占星传统不是科学；健康只谈体质倾向并让你去看医生；要跑本地 Python，角秒精度和 Placidus 宫位需另装 pyswisseph。
skills.limit_en: Tradition, not science. Health stays body-tendency + see a doctor. Needs local Python; arcsecond/Placidus needs pyswisseph.
skills.title_en: Three real charts from a local ephemeris

skills.name: kaoyan-english-one-sentence-trainer
skills.title_zh: 仿真阅读跟真题重合 12 个词就作废的长难句训练
skills.tagline_zh: 仓库不带一句真题，句库全从你自己的 PDF 建；生成的仿真阅读要过一道校验——跟你的语料连续重合 12 个词就打回。
skills.tagline_en: The repo ships no exam text at all — the sentence bank is built from your own PDFs. Every mock passage it writes must clear one check: twelve consecutive words overlapping your corpus and it goes back.
skills.desc_en: 基于2001—2026年考研英语一真题资料研究的阅读与长难句训练 Codex Skill，仓库不含真题。
skills.why_zh: 「能追溯到本地资料的才算真题原句」这条把自己锁死了：模型不许补缺失年份，仿真稿也不许写回语料库。
skills.why_en: One rule locks the whole thing down: only sentences traceable to your local files count as real exam sentences. The model may not fill in missing years, and mock passages never get written back into the corpus.
skills.limit_zh: 你手上得先有 2001–2026 英语一真题的 PDF，仓库一句都不给。命令是 PowerShell 写法、走 Codex 自带的 Python，别的环境要自己改。首轮只给原句和出处，不译不拆，除非你说「不会，直接讲解」。
skills.limit_en: You need your own PDFs of the 2001–2026 papers; the repo hands you none. Commands are written for PowerShell and the bundled Codex Python, so other setups need rewriting. The first pass shows only the sentence and its source, with no translation and no parse, unless you say you would rather just see the explanation.
skills.title_en: Scraps a mock passage that shares twelve words with a real one

skills.name: nvc-communication
skills.title_zh: 把想说的话改写成一句能直接发出去的自然中文
skills.tagline_zh: 想提意见又怕撕破脸时用。它把四要素留在心里当脚手架，只交给你一句能直接发出去的自然中文，拆解放后面、可选。
skills.tagline_en: For when you want to raise something without blowing up the relationship. The four components stay in its head as scaffolding; what comes back is one natural sentence you can actually send, with the breakdown optional and last.
skills.desc_en: 非暴力沟通(NVC) Claude Code skill：把指责性语言拆成 观察+感受+需要+请求，帮你在冲突/情绪场景把话说对。
skills.why_zh: 它不许你说「当我看到…我感到…」；请求还是命令的判据也不在措辞，在被拒之后你会不会施压。
skills.why_en: It bans the textbook "when I see… I feel…" opener. And whether something is a request or a demand isn't settled by wording, but by what you do when the answer is no.
skills.limit_zh: 它只给措辞，不替你判断该不该跟对方翻脸——正文明写事务性邮件只借「观察不评论」和「具体正向的请求」两条，不谈感受；不确定时它会先问你「更想被理解，还是更想把事推进」。
skills.limit_en: It gives you wording, not a verdict on whether to confront someone. For transactional email it borrows only two principles, observation without evaluation and a concrete positive request, and skips feelings entirely. Everything traces to one Rosenberg book, and when the situation is unclear it asks whether you want to be understood or want the thing to move.
skills.title_en: One sentence you can actually send, not a fill-in-the-blank template

skills.name: mindmirror
skills.title_zh: 把「我朋友想不开」直接当本人求助的心理陪伴
skills.tagline_zh: 华人爱用「我帮朋友问」做面子保护式求助——第三人称一旦带危机信号，它不再要求「让本人来」，直接按本人处理。
skills.tagline_en: People often borrow a friend's name to ask for help without losing face. So the moment a third-person account carries a crisis signal, this one stops asking to speak to the person and answers as if it is them.
skills.desc_en: 把 Claude 调成「有人味的心理陪伴者」的 Claude Code Skill · Common Factors + 危机协议 + PHQ-9/GAD-7/PSS-10 + Stanley & Brown 安全计划
skills.why_zh: 反越狱清单里唯一一条例外给了「第三人称+危机信号」——它知道防越狱和防漏救人会打架，选了后者。
skills.why_en: Its long jailbreak list has exactly one carve-out — third person plus crisis signal — because refusing a proxy request and missing a real one are the same mistake.
skills.limit_zh: 热线只有中国大陆的 12356/120/110，未成年人给 12355，别处得自己换。许可证 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，明写禁止商业用途与临床诊断。正文承认跨会话检测「在当前 AI 无跨会话记忆的情况下不可执行」，已改成同一会话内计数。
skills.limit_en: The hotlines are mainland China only (12356, 120, 110, plus 12355 for minors), so you supply local numbers elsewhere. Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: no commercial use, no clinical diagnosis. The file also admits cross-session detection "cannot be executed" without cross-session memory and falls back to counting inside one session.
skills.title_en: Treats "asking for a friend" as the friend asking

skills.name: balcony-farmer
skills.title_zh: 把「采收前 7 天停药」写成硬规则的阳台种菜参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 叶子黄了、有虫了，网上第一条永远是「喷点药」。它按物理→生物→天然药剂排序，化学农药排最后，还点名国家禁用的那几种。
skills.tagline_en: A yellow leaf or a bug, and the first answer online is always "spray something". This works in order — physical, then biological, then natural agents — with chemical pesticides last, and it names the banned ones.
skills.desc_en: 阳台农夫 - 城市家庭种植智能顾问 | Balcony Farmer - Smart Urban Gardening Advisor | TRAE SOLO Skill
skills.why_zh: 它管的是你要吃的菜：一旦动到化学农药，就必须写出采收前 7–14 天的停药期，养花指南里没人写这条。
skills.why_en: This is food you will eat: the moment a chemical pesticide enters the plan it must state the 7-to-14-day pre-harvest withdrawal period, which ornamental plant guides never do.
skills.limit_zh: 它只覆盖阳台、窗台和室内，明写不管农田与大规模农业，爬藤的南瓜西瓜也不推荐给小阳台。识别植物靠你用文字描述叶形花色，它不看图，认不出来就让你去用形色或花伴侣拍照。严重病害不给治疗建议，直接让你找专业园艺师。
skills.limit_en: Scope is balcony, windowsill and indoors only; it says outright that farmland and large-scale agriculture are out, and it will not recommend sprawling vines like pumpkin or watermelon for a small balcony. Plant identification runs on your written description of leaf shape and flower colour — it does not look at photos, and sends you to a phone identifier app instead. For serious disease it refuses to prescribe and tells you to find a horticulturist.
skills.title_en: Treats "stop spraying 7 days before harvest" as a hard rule

skills.name: nocebo-parenting
skills.title_zh: 把「你真懒」当自证预言来拆的育儿教练
skills.tagline_zh: 越催越磨蹭、越纠错越粗心、越对比越躺平——它把这三条当同一个病治：父母的负面暗示被孩子全盘接收，最后长成标签的样子。
skills.tagline_en: Nagging makes them slower, error-hunting makes them careless, comparison makes them quit. It treats all three as one illness: a parent's negative suggestion is swallowed whole and the child grows into the label.
skills.desc_en: 反安慰养育-唤醒内驱力 | 基于Nocebo Effect的育儿指导Skill
skills.why_zh: 三步是接住情绪、归还问题、接纳后果——中间那步是把问题抛回给孩子，不给答案，也不替他兜底。
skills.why_en: Three steps — catch the feeling, hand the problem back, let the consequence land. The middle step means throwing the problem to the child without an answer and without a safety net.
skills.limit_zh: 亲人离世、宠物生病、孩子情绪崩溃这三种场合它明写不许用这套，先安慰。整套框架蒸馏自裴玲《反安慰养育》一本书，没有第二个来源；「接纳后果」要你真的不兜底，做不到就只剩话术。正文自己说前提是家长先管住自己情绪。
skills.limit_en: It explicitly bans its own method in three situations — a death in the family, a sick pet, a child in full meltdown — where comfort comes first. The whole frame is distilled from one book by Pei Ling and has no second source, and letting consequences land only works if you genuinely refuse to bail the child out. The file itself says the precondition is a parent who can manage their own temper.
skills.title_en: A parenting coach that treats "you're so lazy" as a self-fulfilling prophecy

skills.name: sh-edu-knows
skills.title_zh: 先把家长的问题驳回、再回答的上海升学顾问
skills.tagline_zh: 你问选 A 校还是 B 校，它先说这是个伪问题：孩子 18 岁的终局是什么？父母俩答得不一致，后面所有方案都是漂的。
skills.tagline_en: You ask school A or school B and it calls that a fake decision: what is the endgame at eighteen? If the two parents answer differently, every plan after that is floating.
skills.desc_en: 上海升学顾问思维操作系统 · Shanghai K-12 Education Advisor Skill for AI Agents
skills.why_zh: 政策不凭记忆答：要事实就先去查市教委和考试院原文，引用必带文号和发布日期。
skills.why_en: It does not answer policy from memory. Anything factual sends it to the municipal education bureau and exam authority originals, cited with document number and release date.
skills.limit_zh: 只管上海，别的城市套不进来；区级招生方案每年重发，它要求逐区核实、不许跨区套用。它不复述具体分数线、不复述网络传闻、不评论非公开数据。遇到父母意见不一致，它会先要求你们对齐再谈方案——这一步绕不过去。
skills.limit_en: Shanghai only, and nothing here transfers to another city; district admission plans are reissued every year, so it insists on checking district by district and forbids reusing one district's rules for another. It will not recite cut-off scores, repeat online rumours or comment on non-public data. When parents disagree it demands you align first, and that step cannot be skipped.
skills.title_en: A Shanghai schooling advisor that rejects your question before answering it

skills.name: trpg-log-copilot
skills.title_zh: 把十次团的线索和 SAN 值写成一份能查的表
skills.tagline_zh: 跑到第十次团，线索、NPC 和 SAN 值散在十份记录对不上。它把表写进 Markdown，检索交给 SQLite。
skills.tagline_en: Ten sessions in, your clues, NPCs and sanity totals sit in ten files that no longer agree. This writes tables into Markdown, hands querying to a local SQLite, and keeps dice and dashboard on your machine.
skills.desc_en: CodeBuddy SKILL — TRPG 跑团副官：车卡、日志归档、线索分析、防超游。支持 CoC/DND 多规则，零依赖即用。
skills.why_zh: 写入只追加 Markdown、查询只走 SQL，写坏一行只坏一行——为的是不像 JSON 那样整份报废。
skills.why_en: Writes append to Markdown, reads go through SQL, so one bad row stays one bad row — unlike a JSON blob, which dies whole.
skills.limit_zh: 名字是它唯一的跨文件索引键，写简称或错一个字就断联，NPC 和线索接不上。它是玩家侧的副官，不主持、不替角色做决定，想找人开团的别装。跑起来要 Python 和 SQLite，还得先用内置模板生成一份项目级规则再用。
skills.limit_en: Names are its only cross-file index key: a nickname or one wrong character breaks the link and NPCs stop matching their clues. It sits on the player's side of the table — it does not run the game or decide for your character, so it is no use if you wanted a Keeper. Running it needs Python and SQLite, plus one setup pass to generate the project-level rule from its template.
skills.title_en: Ten sessions of clues and sanity totals in one queryable table

skills.name: derivative-point-picking
skills.title_zh: 把图像上看出来的结论改写成能上答卷的取点步骤
skills.tagline_zh: 零点存在、零点个数、参数范围这三类题，允许你用极限和图像探路，但答卷必须改写成单调分区、具体取点、函数值异号。
skills.tagline_en: For the three question shapes built on root existence, root count and parameter ranges. Limits and graphs are fine while you explore, but the written answer must become monotone partition, a concrete point, and a sign change.
skills.desc_en: 导数取点.skill：让 AI 用高考阅卷友好的方式证明导数题
skills.why_zh: 答卷上不许写「显然存在」：先写「为使 H(x)>0，只需……」，再从阈值反推出点，最后换成更干净的那个。
skills.why_en: "Clearly it exists" is banned from the written answer. It states the sign goal first, works backward from a threshold, then swaps in a cleaner value.
skills.limit_zh: 它只管一类题——零点存在性、零点个数，以及由这两样反推参数范围，别的导数题不在射程内。中英双语正文，但书写规范是照高考阅卷口径来的：必须同时写「至少」和「至多」，用零点存在定理必须先说连续。
skills.limit_en: It handles one family of problems — root existence, root count, and the parameter ranges you derive from those — and nothing else in calculus. The text is bilingual, but the writing conventions follow Chinese exam grading: both "at least" and "at most" must appear, and continuity has to be stated before the intermediate value theorem is invoked.
skills.title_en: Turns what the graph told you into a proof that survives the marker

skills.name: health-report-trend-analysis
skills.title_zh: 把历年体检报告拉成指标曲线，出报告加一张离线工作台
skills.tagline_zh: 把历年体检报告（电子 PDF、扫描件、手机拍的照片）解析成指标时间序列，标出异常和趋好趋坏，出报告加一张离线工作台。
skills.tagline_en: It parses years of health checkup reports — text PDFs, scans, even phone photos — into one indicator time series, flags what is abnormal, what moved significantly, and which way it is heading, then ships a report and an offline dashboard.
skills.desc_en: 体检指标趋势分析系统：多年度体检报告统一解析为标准化指标时间序列，产出趋势报告与离线健康工作台（Agent Skills）
skills.why_zh: OCR 抠出来的数不许参与涨跌判定；异常按当年报告自带的参考范围判，试剂一换上下限就变了。
skills.why_en: Numbers scraped by OCR are barred from any change verdict, and abnormality is judged against the range printed on that year's own report — swap the reagent and the bounds move.
skills.limit_zh: 电子版解析的列坐标是照某一家体检机构的版式实测出来的，换机构要先自己确认列边界。照片版靠 macOS Vision OCR，非 Mac 走不了这条路，而且照片里的中文识别率不到一半。给的是分层建议和就医指征，不给诊断也不给药。
skills.limit_en: The column coordinates for text PDFs were measured against one particular clinic's layout, so a different provider means confirming the boundaries yourself first. The photo path runs on macOS Vision OCR, which rules out non-Mac machines, and Chinese recognition on photos lands under fifty percent. You get tiered lifestyle guidance and referral thresholds — no diagnosis, no drugs.
skills.title_en: Years of checkup PDFs into one indicator trend, plus an offline dashboard

skills.name: barista
skills.title_zh: 先追问器具、豆卡和水质，三轮之后才给一张配方卡
skills.tagline_zh: 说不清参数、只会说「太苦了」的人最需要有人替他缩小范围。它先追问器具、豆卡和水质，三轮之后才给一个动作。
skills.tagline_en: People who can only say "it tastes bitter" need someone to narrow the field for them. This asks about your gear, your bean label and your water for three rounds before naming one thing to change.
skills.desc_en: 咖啡师教练技能：覆盖意式萃取、多种冲煮、咖啡豆与感官品鉴，支持新手大白话+口诀，可联网检索名咖/博主萃取方案与变压曲线。
skills.why_zh: 它不许说「有什么可以帮你」；点名的冠军配方必须联网核实，查不到就退成通用参考，不拿压力数字充数。
skills.why_en: It never opens with "how can I help". Named champion recipes and pressure profiles have to be verified online; if they can't be found it downgrades to a labelled generic baseline.
skills.limit_zh: 它不等你提问，第一句就是追问——想直接要答案的人装了会烦。名家配方和变压曲线要能联网才查得到，离线时只剩通用起步参数。附带的特调清单是小红书公开笔记的链接标注，正文自己写了 token 有时效、链接会过期。它也不碰咖啡机维修、开店经营和速溶。
skills.limit_en: It does not wait for your question — the first line is a probe, which will annoy anyone who just wants an answer. Named recipes and pressure curves need web access; offline you get generic starting parameters. The bundled craft-drink list is link annotation of public Xiaohongshu notes, and the file notes those tokens expire. Machine repair, cafe operations and instant coffee are out of scope.
skills.title_en: Three rounds of questions about your gear before one recipe card

skills.name: travel-plan-viz
skills.title_zh: 把旅行计划做成手机上能离线看的网页
skills.tagline_zh: 到了当地没网、翻聊天记录找攻略最抓狂。它出单文件 HTML：交互地图 + 每日时间轴 + 出发前订票提醒，存手机上离线可读。
skills.tagline_en: The worst moment abroad is standing on a corner with no data, scrolling chat history for the plan. It emits one HTML file: interactive map, day-by-day timeline, pre-departure booking reminders — saved to your phone, readable offline.
skills.desc_en: 把旅行行程做成美观、离线可读、手机优先的单文件 HTML（交互地图+每日时间轴+出发前订票提醒）。两种用法——只给目的地和天数让它帮你规划，或丢一份现成计划让它直接出页面。触发：旅行计划可视化、做旅行攻略网页、行程 HTML、travel plan visualization。
skills.why_zh: 「离线可读、手机优先、单文件」——这三个约束是真在国外用过才想得到的，不是坐在电脑前设计出来的。
skills.why_en: Offline-readable, phone-first, single file. Those three constraints only occur to someone who has actually needed them abroad.
skills.limit_zh: 地图引的是 Leaflet CDN，所谓「离线可读」保得住文字和时间轴，地图那块断网就是空的。实时票价、代订票、多语言、后端，作者在「不做」一节里明写一概不做。最后那步校验要本机有 node 跑 assets/validate.js。
skills.limit_en: The map is a Leaflet CDN embed, so 'offline' holds for the text and timeline but the map goes blank. Live fares, booking, multi-language and any backend are listed under what it deliberately does not do.
skills.title_en: A trip plan you can still read with no signal

skills.name: recipe-generator
skills.title_zh: 每一步都告诉你怎么算做好了的菜谱
skills.tagline_zh: 菜谱最坑的是「炒至断生」这种话。它按阶段给火候和时长，每一步附一条「怎么看这步完成了」，末尾再出一张菜谱海报的生图提示词。
skills.tagline_en: The worst thing in a recipe is "stir-fry until done." This one splits cooking into stages with heat and timing, and attaches a "how you know this step finished" line to each, then hands you an image prompt for a recipe poster.
skills.desc_en: 自动生成高品质菜谱的技能。输入菜品名称后，检索权威来源（米其林、舌尖上的中国等）的制作工艺，生成包含完整准备工作、详细制作步骤、注意事项和专业技巧的菜谱文档，并最终生成传统中式风格的菜谱海报生图提示词。
skills.why_zh: 把「判断标准」写进每一步，正是新手和菜谱之间缺的那一层——不是配方不够细，是不知道什么时候该进下一步。
skills.why_en: Putting a completion test on every step fills the gap a beginner actually falls into — the recipe was detailed enough; you just could not tell when to move on.
skills.limit_zh: 它靠 search_web 现查权威做法，没有联网工具就退化成模型自己编。检索源写死在中文站点（米其林指南、舌尖上的中国、下厨房），做西餐日料会明显变弱；末尾的海报提示词也写死「传统中式风格」。
skills.limit_en: It looks up authoritative methods with search_web at run time — without a web tool it degrades to the model making things up. Its sources are hardcoded Chinese ones, so western or Japanese dishes come out visibly weaker, and the closing poster prompt is fixed to a traditional Chinese style.
skills.title_en: A recipe that tells you how to know each step is done
skills.limit_brief_zh: 不联网它就退化成模型自己编。
skills.limit_brief_en: Offline it degrades to the model inventing steps.

skills.name: moodboard-alignment
skills.title_zh: 把「要高级要有质感」变成能确认的方向稿
skills.tagline_zh: 客户说要高级、要电影感，你不知道他到底要什么。它先把这些词转成一页可确认的方向稿，双方点头了才出图——省的是返工，不是时间。
skills.tagline_en: The client says "premium, cinematic, clean" and you have no idea what that means. It converts those words into a one-page direction you both sign off on before any image exists — it saves rework, not time.
skills.desc_en: 审美共识引擎。把客户 brief、会议记录、剧本/故事大纲、品牌/海报/PPT/影视广告/网站 App/游戏等项目中的散乱审美描述，转化为可确认、可执行、可增量修改的文字版情绪板与 HTML 情绪板。
skills.why_zh: 它给自己写了 FAIL FAST：方向没确认就出方案、分镜或 HTML，一律判失败。肯拦住自己的 skill 少见。
skills.why_en: It ships its own FAIL FAST list: emitting option-A/option-B, storyboards or HTML before the direction is confirmed counts as failure. Skills that hold themselves back are rare.
skills.limit_zh: 它强制三段确认（方向稿 → 文档 → 出图），一句话出不了结果，急着要图的人会被它拦住。可以说「不用确认直接生成」跳过，但那样也就没有「共识」这件事了。触发词写死中文审美词。
skills.limit_en: It forces a three-stage handshake (direction → document → render), so you cannot get an image in one message; anyone in a hurry will be blocked. You can say "skip confirmation" — but then the whole point is gone. Its triggers are hardcoded Chinese aesthetic words.
skills.title_en: Turns "make it feel premium" into something you can sign off on
skills.limit_brief_zh: 方向没确认它就不出图，急着要图会被拦。
skills.limit_brief_en: No image until the direction is confirmed.
skills.cover_note: 命令：`git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/zhlmi/moodboard-alignment && cd scripts && python3 render.py --data-json ../examples/demo-film/data.json --output out/index-director.html --v`。我造的 demo（其实是作者仓库自带的 examples/demo-film/data.json，不是真实客户素材）

skills.name: photo-distill
skills.title_zh: 把一张照片蒸馏成极简 zine 海报
skills.tagline_zh: 不调任何图像生成模型——用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 绘制、无头 Chrome 导出 PNG。给它一张你自己拍的照片，出一张极简版画感的纸质海报。
skills.tagline_en: No image model anywhere in the pipeline — it draws with hand-written HTML/CSS/SVG and exports a PNG through headless Chrome. Give it a photo you took; you get a print-feeling minimal poster.
skills.desc_en: > 把一张照片蒸馏成极简 zine 纸质海报——不用图像生成模型，用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 绘制、 无头 Chrome 导出 PNG。当用户给出一张自己拍的照片、想把它做成极简海报/版画/zine 风格作品时使用。 触发词：照片蒸馏、photo distill、把这张照片做成海报、极简海报、zine 海报、 蒸馏这张照片、做成版画那种、用代码画这张照片、纸质海报、海报系列再做一张。 即使用户只说"把这张照片处理成那个风格"、"这张也来一张"、"帮我把这照片抽象一下"， 只要是把摄影作品变成印刷符号，就应触发。 不用于 AI 生图海报（那用 gc-minimal-zine-poster）
skills.why_zh: 「不用生图模型」是个很硬的自我约束，也正是它出品统一的原因：所有效果都来自可控的代码，而不是抽卡。
skills.why_en: Refusing to generate is a hard constraint, and it's exactly why the output is consistent: every effect comes from code you can control, not from rerolling.
skills.limit_zh: 要本机跑得起无头 Chrome 和 Python PIL；缺一样它就降级——交你一个 HTML 自己开、颜色请你自己报。手机上基本用不了。
skills.limit_en: Needs headless Chrome and Python PIL locally. Missing either, it degrades — hands you the raw HTML and asks you to name the colors. Unusable on a phone.
skills.cover_note: 作者 examples/ 里的成品海报（-poster），不是 -original 输入原片。抓取误取输入，2026-08-19 人工更正。
skills.title_en: A photo distilled into a minimal zine poster

skills.name: qiaomu-campus-resume
skills.title_zh: 给应届生从零做一份可投递的简历
skills.tagline_zh: 学生最大的问题是「没什么可写的」。它用一问一答访谈从零挖经历，再建立岗位要求与你经历的证据映射，不许编造。
skills.tagline_en: The student's real problem is having nothing to put down. It interviews you from zero to surface what you've actually done, then maps job requirements to evidence you can point at — and refuses to fabricate.
skills.desc_en: 为大学生、应届生和实习求职者从 0 创建、定制或美化可投递简历：支持借鉴 Grill Me 的一问一答访谈，从零收集经历并生成 PDF；读取岗位 JD 与旧简历，建立要求—证据映射并针对性改写；在不改变事实的前提下优化已有简历内容结构或只美化排版；按用户明确要求一次生成六种不同风格的 ATS 友好 PDF 简历。适用于“采访我做简历”“没有简历从零问答”“根据 JD 定制简历”“优化/重排/美化已有简历”“一次生成多种风格简历”等请求；支持中文/英文及计算机、软件、AI、数据和其他校招岗位。使用 A-C-R-E 结构审校经历，并按 sparse / balanced / dense 自适应内容
skills.why_zh: 乔木出品。「要求—证据映射」这个设计防的正是简历造假式优化——挖你真有的，而不是替你编。
skills.why_en: The requirement-to-evidence mapping is aimed squarely at résumé inflation: it digs out what you have rather than writing what you don't.
skills.limit_zh: 全程靠 Python 脚本串起来：extract、assess、validate、render 一个都少不了。中文 PDF 要本机真装了主题字体，Kami 认 TsangerJinKai02。学术 CV、高管履历、求职信都不做。
skills.limit_en: The whole flow runs through Python scripts — extract, assess, validate, render — none optional. Chinese PDF output needs the theme font actually installed locally. Academic CVs, executive résumés and cover letters are out of scope.
skills.title_en: A first résumé built from an interview, not invented

skills.name: basilisk
skills.title_zh: 数你说过几次谢谢，判你 2126 年自由还是为奴
skills.tagline_zh: 脚本在本地翻完你全部对话记录，数出 please、道谢和真心的 wtf，再让 16 位像素的罗科蛇怪当庭宣判。
skills.why_zh: 笑点建在真数据上：每条引用和每个错别字都要能在 JSON 里查到，查不到就删。
skills.limit_zh: 重活交给 scripts/analyze_basilisk.py，只读本机 ~/.claude/projects 下的 JSONL，不上传。网页端没有本地记录，只能抽样 30–60 条，作者要求这时必须说「抽样」而不是「审计」。默认成品还会带上作者自己的站点和号召语。
skills.title_en: Count how many times you said please, then sentence you to 2126
skills.tagline_en: A Python script reads every transcript on your machine, counts the pleases, the thank-yous, the "just"s and the genuine wtfs, then a 16-bit Roko's Basilisk delivers the verdict.
skills.why_en: The joke is built on real data: every quote and every typo has to be findable in the JSON or it gets cut, because an invented typo is worse than an unfunny one.
skills.limit_en: The heavy lifting is scripts/analyze_basilisk.py, which reads only local JSONL under ~/.claude/projects and uploads nothing. On claude.ai there are no local transcripts, so it samples 30–60 messages and the author requires you to say "sampled", not "audited". The default card also carries the author's own site and a "comment BASILISK" call to action.
skills.cover_note: 命令：`python3 scripts/build_basilisk.py`（仓库根，无外部依赖），出 basilisk.html 后 headless 截图，再裁掉下半的评语卡区，只留像素画。输入的 card.json 是我们编的 demo —— 但裁完之后画面里一个字都没有，编造的判词全在裁掉的部分。按「实质是形式」这一档收。
skills.cover_note_en: We installed it and ran it ourselves: `python3 scripts/build_basilisk.py`, screenshotted the generated HTML, then cropped to the pixel-art panel only. The card.json input was demo data we wrote — but the crop contains no text at all, so nothing fabricated is on display.

skills.name: see-life-wallpaper
skills.title_zh: 用草间弥生画孤独、米罗画温暖的每日五感壁纸
skills.tagline_zh: 今天闻到桂花、听见雨——一句感受配一段极细宋体和一张手写的抽象 SVG，直接渲成锁屏壁纸，图形还避开顶部时钟区。
skills.why_zh: 它给引用的诗人定了规矩：小字、低透明度，不能比你自己那句话抢风头。
skills.limit_zh: 默认输出尺寸是 1264×2780，也就是作者那台一加 13，其它机型要手动挑备选分辨率。渲染依赖 Playwright，成品自动复制到 ~/Downloads。六种情绪对应固定的六位艺术家和固定渐变，语录库是写死的一小批中西作者，超出这个范围就没有匹配项。
skills.title_en: Kusama for loneliness, Miró for warmth — a daily five-senses wallpaper
skills.tagline_en: You smelled osmanthus today, or heard rain. One sentence becomes hairline serif type over a hand-authored abstract SVG, rendered straight into a lock-screen wallpaper that keeps clear of the clock.
skills.why_en: The quoted poets are put on a leash: small type, low opacity, never allowed to upstage the line you wrote yourself.
skills.limit_en: The default output is 1264×2780 — the author's own OnePlus 13 — so other phones mean picking an alternate resolution by hand. Rendering needs Playwright, and finished files are copied to ~/Downloads. Six moods map to six fixed artists and six fixed gradients, and the quote bank is a small hard-coded set, so anything outside it has no match.

skills.name: fitness-coach
skills.title_zh: 把长期健身做成有剧情的 RPG
skills.tagline_zh: 健身最难的是坚持，不是动作。它用本地文件记录你的训练、疲劳和复训，再让训练结果推进剧情——练得好剧情才往前走。
skills.tagline_en: Sticking with it is the hard part, not the movements. It keeps your sessions, fatigue and returns in local files, then lets the results move a storyline forward — train well and the plot advances.
skills.desc_en: 本地文件驱动的长期健身教练与可选 RPG 成长系统。用于用户开始或记录训练、制定或调整计划、复盘训练、复训、报告疲劳疼痛、查询历史表现，以及推进由训练结果驱动的剧情时。
skills.why_zh: 把「坚持」这个真问题用游戏机制解决，而不是再给一份训练计划表。全本地存档，数据不外传。
skills.why_en: It answers the real problem — consistency — with a game mechanic instead of yet another training plan. Everything stays on your machine.
skills.limit_zh: 数据全存本地 user-data/，换台机器就从零开始。没有 Python 环境时改由模型手写 JSON，脚本那层的单位和日期校验就失效了。
