skills.limit_en: All data lives in a local user-data/ folder; switch machines and you start over. Without Python it falls back to the model hand-writing JSON, losing the script's unit and date checks.
skills.title_en: Long-term training as a story you unlock

skills.name: iching-divination
skills.title_zh: 用密码学随机数起卦的周易占卜
skills.tagline_zh: AI 算卦最没意思的是它会顺着你想听的编卦象。这个用密码学级随机数模拟三枚铜钱，一事一占，凶卦如实直断，还能事后对账验证。
skills.tagline_en: The dull thing about AI fortune-telling is that it quietly tells you what you want to hear. This one casts three coins with a cryptographic RNG, allows one question per casting, states bad hexagrams plainly, and invites you back to check whether it was right.
skills.desc_en: 真随机起卦的周易/易经占卜。用密码学级随机数模拟三枚铜钱起卦,绝不编造卦象;一事一占;按传统规范解读本卦、动爻、之卦,先引原文再讲白话;凶卦如实直断;支持事后对账验证。只要用户提到占卜、算卦、起卦、问卦、解卦、摇卦、占一卦、六十四卦、易经、周易、卦象,或想用易经视角推演某个决定(跳槽、感情、合作、出行、时机),就使用本 skill,即使他没有明说"占卜"二字。Authentic I Ching (Yijing/Zhouyi) divination - cryptographically random coin casting, classical hexagram interpretation
skills.why_zh: 「绝不编造卦象」「凶卦如实直断」——它把占卜里最容易滑坡的那两处堵死了。认真对待玩的东西，本身就是一种品味。
skills.why_en: It seals the two places divination usually slides: no inventing hexagrams, no softening a bad one. Taking a game seriously is itself a kind of taste.
skills.limit_zh: 一事一占是硬规矩，你连问几件它会引蒙卦拒绝。也不答彩票号码、不替你做医疗和财务决定。
skills.limit_en: One question per casting is enforced — ask several and it refuses, citing the Meng hexagram. It won't pick lottery numbers or make medical and financial decisions for you.
skills.title_en: Divination by I Ching, with cryptographic dice

skills.name: ljg-writes
skills.title_zh: 把一个观点写成经得住反例的文章
skills.tagline_zh: AI 写观点文最容易变成正确的废话。它的目标很具体：1000-1500 字，可理解、可迁移、经得住反例——而且明说不做普通摘要。
skills.tagline_en: AI opinion pieces default to being correct and empty. This one sets a specific bar: 1000–1500 words, understandable, transferable, and able to survive counterexamples — and it explicitly refuses to write summaries.
skills.desc_en: "写作引擎。把一个观点写成可理解、可迁移、经得住反例的 1000-1500 字中文文章。USE WHEN 写文章 OR 优化思想内容 OR 展开观点 OR 改写成逻辑递进的中文。NOT FOR 普通摘要、事实查询或结构风洞（用 ljg-structure）。"
skills.why_zh: 「经得住反例」是我见过对写作最狠的自我要求，比「高质量」这类词实在得多。作者知道自己在做什么。
skills.why_en: 'Survives counterexamples' is the most demanding thing I've seen a writing skill ask of itself. Far more concrete than claiming 'high quality'.
skills.limit_zh: 产出直接落成 Org 文件写进 ~/Documents/notes，文件头的 author 写死「李继刚」，保存后还要过 org-lint 和 Denote 校验——不用 Emacs/Org 的人得先拆掉这一整套。默认 1000–1500 字，摘要和事实查询作者明写不接。
skills.limit_en: Output lands as Org files in ~/Documents/notes with the author field hard-coded, then runs org-lint and Denote checks. If you don't use Emacs and Org, you're dismantling that whole stack first.
skills.title_en: An argument built to survive counterexamples

skills.name: multi-copywrite-alchemy
skills.title_zh: 分析某位作者的多篇文章复刻其文风
skills.tagline_zh: 想学某个人的写法，读十篇也说不清他到底怎么写的。它拆解一位作者的多篇文章还原其思维方式，生成专属写作分身和风格提示词。
skills.tagline_en: Reading ten pieces still won't tell you how someone actually writes. This takes a body of one author's work apart, reconstructs how they think, and gives you a writing persona plus style prompts.
skills.desc_en: 复刻蒸馏写作技能 —— 分析一位作者的多篇文章，深度还原其思维方式与写作风格，生成专属写作分身子技能与风格提示词。支持公众号、抖音多平台自动采集素材，也可手动粘贴文章或指定文件路径。触发词：蒸馏写作风格、写作分身、克隆写作风格、复刻蒸馏写作技能。
skills.why_zh: 「还原思维方式」比「模仿句式」高一档——前者能迁移到新题材，后者换个题目就露馅。
skills.why_en: Reconstructing the thinking beats mimicking the sentences — the first transfers to new subjects, the second falls apart the moment the topic changes.
skills.limit_zh: 要去作者自家 redfox.hk 注册拿 REDFOX_API_KEY 配成环境变量才跑得动，平台采集只覆盖公众号和抖音。素材少于 3 篇 2000 字别指望还原，理想量作者标的是 10 篇 1 万字。核心流程在 references/core_workflow.md。
skills.limit_en: Needs a REDFOX_API_KEY from the author's own redfox.hk, and its collection covers only WeChat and Douyin. Under three pieces or 2000 words there's nothing to reconstruct; the author's stated target is ten pieces, 10k words.
skills.title_en: Reverse-engineer a writer's voice from their work

skills.name: official-document-writing
skills.title_zh: 按 GB/T 9704 规范写党政机关公文
skills.tagline_zh: 请示、通知、函、纪要——体制内的公文错一个格式就要返工。它按国标给格式规范、模板和用语建议，还带质量检查。
skills.desc_en: 专业的党政机关公文写作指南。当用户需要撰写、修改或审核党政机关公文（如请示、通知、函、总结、纪要等）时使用。提供GB/T 9704-2012格式规范指导、常用公文模板、语言规范建议和公文质量检查。适用于以下场景：(1) 撰写新公文，(2) 修改完善公文，(3) 检查公文格式规范，(4) 提供公文写作指导，(5) 审核公文质量。
skills.why_zh: 极致垂直，而且是国外市场绝不会有的东西。作者引了具体国标号，说明他真的在这行里。
skills.unshelve_reason: C 端全球化转向（店主 2026-08-19）：党政机关公文是职业工具 + 中国体制限定，两条都不符合新方向。它本身质量没问题（引具体国标号、作者真在这行里），是定位不匹配，不是货不好。留档随时可翻回。
skills.limit_zh: 它管 GB/T 9704 的格式与用语，不管这份文该不该发、内容对不对。全文没写任何适用边界，实质内容还是你自己扛。
skills.limit_en: It covers GB/T 9704 formatting and register — not whether the document should be sent or whether its content is right. No stated boundaries anywhere in the skill.

skills.name: fengshui-master
skills.title_zh: 先说自己不算命的风水顾问
skills.tagline_zh: 看房时想问朝向旺位煞气，网上说法互相打架。它按三元玄空飞星、八宅明镜、形势峦头三套体系分开算，不合并成一个答案糊弄你。
skills.why_zh: 诚实段先引经典说风水辅佐不决定命运。一个会先缩小自己主张的术数，反而更好信。
skills.limit_zh: 三套体系常互相打架，并排展示不替你裁决。葬法地域差异极大，别当通例。
skills.tagline_en: You want to ask about orientation, favourable sectors and sha positions, and every source online contradicts the last. This runs three systems separately — Flying Star, Eight Mansions, and form-and-landform — instead of blending them into one confident answer.
skills.why_en: Its honesty section quotes the classics to say feng shui assists but does not determine fate. A practice that shrinks its own claim first is easier to trust.
skills.limit_en: The three systems routinely disagree with each other; it shows them side by side and won't adjudicate for you. Burial-site practice varies enormously by region — don't read it as a general rule.
skills.title_en: A feng shui adviser that opens by limiting itself

skills.name: TCM.Skill
skills.title_zh: 会劝你去挂急诊的中医参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 家里人不舒服，最难的是判断「要不要现在就去医院」。它把疑似致命的情况列成红线层——高热神昏、胸痛彻背、假神脱汗，一律叫急救不辨证。
skills.why_zh: 这类里我见过最安全的边界：先点名「传统框架拖成急诊」的失败模式，并在红线层直接拒绝辨证。
skills.limit_zh: 定位是「家庭参谋而非医师」，不出处方。针刺绝对禁止自行操作，只解释指路。教材派立场，与经方派、温病派的结论会不一致，它不替你调和。 上游 SKILL.md 的 name 是中文「中医」，装上后可能不被识别，改成 tcm 更稳。 门面说不出处方，但硬约束文件给了 101 味毒性药的内服克数 —— 那是上限表，不是处方。
skills.tagline_en: The hard call at home is not which remedy — it's whether to go to hospital now. It puts suspected life-threatening presentations in a red-line tier: high fever with confusion, chest pain through to the back, cold sweat — call emergency services, no differentiation.
skills.why_en: The safest boundary I've seen in this category. It names the failure mode where a traditional framework delays real care, and refuses to be used there.
skills.limit_en: Positioned as a family adviser, not a physician; it writes no prescriptions. Self-administered acupuncture is forbidden outright, explanation only. It argues from the textbook tradition and will not reconcile itself with rival schools. Upstream's name field is Chinese, so the loader may not pick it up — rename it to tcm. The facade writes no prescriptions, yet its hard-constraint file lists oral gram doses for 101 toxic herbs — read them as ceilings, not prescriptions.
skills.title_en: Traditional medicine that tells you to call an ambulance

skills.name: coc-kp-host
skills.title_zh: 写到第三段就把回合交回来的克苏鲁跑团 KP
skills.tagline_zh: AI 当 KP 最烦的是一口气把三个场景演完。它给自己设了硬上限：一回合一拍、2–4 句，停在你能动手的那一刻。
skills.why_zh: 队友 NPC 是 AI 扮的调查员不是提示频道：不许总结主线、不许给路线排正确度，要拿信息也得掷骰。
skills.limit_zh: 模组正文得你自己有——它明写有原文时不许凭记忆讲，没有原文就只能即兴。配乐是在浏览器里开一个搜索结果页，作者承认查不到具体曲目时就让你自己按播放。它还会照模组把 1920 年代的种族歧视当成线索门禁执行，只在开局前问你能接受到什么程度。
skills.tagline_en: The worst thing an AI Keeper does is play three scenes in one breath. This caps itself hard: one beat per turn, two to four sentences, stopping where you can act.
skills.why_en: Companion NPCs are run as AI-played investigators, not hint channels: they may not summarise the plot or rank routes by correctness, and must roll like anyone else to learn things.
skills.limit_en: You have to supply the scenario text yourself — the file forbids narrating from memory when canon exists, and without it the Keeper is improvising. Music opens a search-results page in your browser, and the author admits it tells you to hit play when a specific track cannot be verified. It will also enforce 1920s racism as a clue gate when the module calls for it, checking your comfort level only once before play.
skills.title_en: Hands the turn back the moment it starts a third paragraph

skills.name: system-fitness-advisor
skills.title_zh: 按你的训练记录算下一次该练什么
skills.tagline_zh: 健身 skill 大多发你一张通用计划表。它要的是你的训记、CSV 或截图，然后只答一件事：下次练什么、加多少、要不要减量。
skills.tagline_en: Most fitness skills hand you a generic template. This one wants your actual log — CSV, JSON, or a screenshot — and answers one question: what to do next session, how much to add, whether to deload.
skills.desc_en: Turn the user's actual training evidence into the smallest useful next decision. Return a concrete next session or a bounded change to the current plan, not a generic template.
skills.why_zh: 它把胸痛、晕厥、放射性麻木写成硬停止条件，还默认只读、不回显任何 key——一个健身件肯写这两条，作者是认真的。
skills.why_en: Chest pain, fainting and radiating numbness are hard stop conditions in the file itself, and it defaults to read-only, never echoing keys. A fitness skill bothering with either is a sign the author is serious.
skills.limit_zh: 没有训练记录它就退化成通用建议——它全部的价值建立在你手上已经有训记、CSV 或 JSON。作者明写不做医疗诊断、不接与训练无关的营养查询；出现胸痛晕厥这类信号它会停下让你去看急诊，不会继续排计划。
skills.limit_en: Without a training log it degrades into generic advice — its whole value rests on you already having data (Xunji, CSV or JSON). The author states plainly it does not diagnose, refuses nutrition-only questions, and stops programming entirely on emergency symptoms.
skills.title_en: Reads your training log and decides your next session
skills.limit_brief_zh: 没有训练记录，它只能给通用建议。
skills.limit_brief_en: With no training log, it can only give generic advice.

skills.name: hemingway-perspective
skills.title_zh: 用海明威的冰山理论帮你改写作
skills.tagline_zh: 想让文字硬一点、少一点形容词，却说不清怎么改。它用冰山理论、极简短句和硬汉式克制来回应——只谈写作，不扮演海明威本人。
skills.tagline_en: You want the prose harder and the adjectives gone but can't say how. It answers through iceberg theory, short declaratives and hard-boiled restraint — and it discusses writing only; it does not play Hemingway.
skills.desc_en: >- 用海明威的冰山理论、极简短句与硬汉式克制来回应写作与表达相关的问题 当用户明确要求使用这一人物的视角、提到“hemingway-perspective”，或希望应用其核心方法分析问题时使用；不要因一般性问题自动触发。
skills.why_zh: 「不要用来扮演本人」这条边界划得清醒：它做的是方法迁移，不是角色扮演。这个分寸是品味。
skills.why_en: 'Do not use this to impersonate the man' is a clear-eyed boundary: it transfers a method, it doesn't cosplay an author. That sense of proportion is taste.
skills.limit_zh: 作者明说不因一般问题自动触发，得你点名叫它。而且只对写作和表达类问题有用，拿它聊别的等于没装。
skills.limit_en: The author explicitly disables auto-triggering — you have to call it by name. It only helps with writing and expression; for anything else it may as well not be installed.
skills.title_en: Iceberg theory applied to your draft

skills.name: wujutong
skills.title_zh: 按三焦辨证给温病方，古人矛盾处照原样留着
skills.tagline_zh: 温病和伤寒是两套打法，用错了会反着治。它按《温病条辨》三焦辨证走，22 首方按上中下焦排开，359 个医案双索引。
skills.why_zh: 有一节叫「内部张力——保留，不调和」。古人自相矛盾处留着缝，并点名对立学派把你送过去。
skills.limit_zh: 只做温病；伤寒、杂病、气化学派不在范围，作者分别指路。不出处方；安全说明单独成节。
skills.tagline_en: Warm-disease theory and cold-damage theory are two different games; use the wrong one and you treat backwards. This follows the triple-burner differentiation, 22 core formulas laid out by burner, 359 case records double-indexed.
skills.why_en: One section is titled 'internal tensions — kept, not reconciled'. Where the classical author contradicts himself, it leaves the seam visible. It also names the rival school by skill and sends you there.
skills.limit_en: Warm disease only — cold damage, miscellaneous disease and the qi-dynamic school are out of scope and the author points each one elsewhere. No prescriptions; safety notice in its own section.
skills.title_en: Triple-burner differentiation for warm diseases — contradictions in the classics left standing

skills.name: baoxiao
skills.title_zh: 一堆发票变成合规报销单，带查重台账
skills.tagline_zh: 报销最烦的不是填表，是发票散在微信、邮箱和拍照里，还得防重复报。它先按统一规范重命名归档，再出封面汇总加逐票明细的 PDF 包。
skills.why_zh: 加了一张发票查重台账 CSV——这不是做产品的人会想到的功能，是真报过销、真被打回来过的人才会加。
skills.limit_zh: 吃增值税电子发票 PDF 和纸质发票照片，照片走视觉识别，模糊或反光的会认错，核对那一步是必做不是可选。合规口径按通用要求，各公司财务规矩不一。
skills.tagline_en: The annoying part of expenses isn't the form, it's that the receipts are scattered across chat, email and photos — and you have to avoid claiming one twice. It renames and files them to a convention first, then produces a cover summary plus per-receipt detail PDF.
skills.why_en: It ships a duplicate-check ledger as a CSV. That isn't a feature a product person invents; it's one someone adds after finance has bounced their claim.
skills.limit_en: Handles Chinese VAT e-invoice PDFs and photos of paper receipts; photos go through vision and blurry or glared ones misread, so the verification step is required, not optional. Mainland China invoicing conventions.
skills.title_en: Loose receipts into a filed expense claim

skills.name: chinese-baby-naming
skills.title_zh: 全家为起名吵架时出来当中间人
skills.tagline_zh: 起名难的从来不是想不出字，是爷爷要字辈、妈妈嫌笔画多、爸爸信五行。它专门做了协商模式，把冲突摆到台面上一条条谈。
skills.why_zh: 反模式写得清醒：没给出生时刻绝不伪造命盘；不为凑五行去用冷僻字——「孩子要写、要被叫一辈子」。
skills.limit_zh: 不做店名/品牌/宠物/游戏角色/虚构名，不做纯算命、不解读已有名字。方言校验只覆盖它掌握的语组。
skills.tagline_en: Naming a Chinese child is never short of characters — it's short of agreement: grandfather wants the generation character, mother says too many strokes, father wants the five elements balanced. It has a negotiation mode that puts the conflict on the table.
skills.why_en: The anti-patterns section is unusually clear-eyed: never fake a birth chart when no birth time was given, never reach for a rare character to balance the elements — 'the child will write it and hear it mispronounced for a lifetime'.
skills.limit_en: It refuses shops, brands, pets, game characters and fictional names, and won't do pure fortune-telling or interpret an existing name. Dialect checks cover only the language groups it knows; where it doesn't know, it says so.
skills.title_en: Mediating the family argument about the baby's name

skills.name: beijing-pollen-monitor
skills.title_zh: 查北京 16 区花粉浓度和过敏预报
skills.tagline_zh: 每年三四月对花粉过敏的人来说是渡劫。它拉 16 个站点的实时监测和分类预报，按区查，出门前知道今天该不该戴口罩。
skills.tagline_en: March and April are an ordeal if you're allergic. It pulls live readings and graded forecasts from 16 monitoring stations, queryable by district, so you know before you leave whether to mask up.
skills.desc_en: 查询北京花粉实时监测和预报数据，生成包含区级浓度、站点趋势、总量预报与分类预报的结果。北京 16 个固定站点，每区一个，用区名指定。 user-invocable: true argument-hint: "[report|overview|stations|history|forecast|daily] [--district 海淀] [options]"
skills.why_zh: 垂直到一个城市、一种过敏原——但对那批人是刚需。这种「窄得理直气壮」正是大市场覆盖不到的东西。
skills.why_en: Narrow to one city and one allergen — and for those people it's essential. That kind of unembarrassed narrowness is exactly what a large marketplace never covers.
skills.limit_zh: metadata 里明写要本机有 curl 和 jq，全靠 scripts/beijing-pollen-query.sh 打公开接口。范围钉死北京 16 区，作者写明北京以外不要用。而且它只查不推——「每天早上发我」那种晨报要调用方自己接。
skills.limit_en: Its metadata requires curl and jq locally and everything runs through one shell script against a public endpoint. Pinned to Beijing's 16 districts; the author says plainly not to use it elsewhere. It queries on demand and does not push.
skills.title_en: Pollen by district, for one city that needs it

skills.name: create-larp-character
skills.title_zh: 把剧本杀角色蒸馏成能继续聊天的 AI
skills.tagline_zh: 散场之后角色就没了，但你可能还想跟 ta 说话。丢进玩家本和人物小传 PDF，它拆出故事记忆和人物性格，生成一个能持续对话的角色。
skills.why_zh: 安全边界写着不泄露核心诡计和凶手、不透露该角色本不该知道的秘密——一个角色扮演工具主动防剧透，说明作者真在玩这个。
skills.limit_zh: 只用于个人情感体验，不该拿去帮别人过本。素材质量决定成品：小传写得薄，蒸馏出来的角色也薄。需要读写文件权限。
skills.tagline_en: The character disappears when the session ends, but you might still want to talk to them. Feed it the player script and character bio as PDF; it extracts story memory and personality into a character you can keep talking to.
skills.why_en: Its safety section refuses to leak the core trick or the culprit, and won't reveal what the character shouldn't know. A roleplay tool that guards against spoilers on its own is written by someone who actually plays.
skills.limit_en: For personal enjoyment only — not for helping someone else through a game they haven't played. Output quality follows the source: a thin bio yields a thin character. Needs file read/write permission.
skills.title_en: Keep talking to a murder-mystery character after the game

skills.name: feline-health-advisory
skills.title_zh: 替猫拦下云南白药和藿香正气的养猫参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 猫吐了、乱尿了、咬人了，中文经验帖和「打一下就记住」全是坑；它先过一遍急诊红旗再答，答案对齐国际猫科福利指南。
skills.why_zh: 它把「不给剂量」做成硬规则：连人用药折算、朋友说、写科普这几种绕法都点名堵死。
skills.limit_zh: 正文明写不给任何药物剂量、频次、疗程，即便用户声称兽医已给过指示也不替他补全。点名拒绝云南白药、藿香正气、蒙脱石散这类家庭偏方。只管猫不管狗；无法联网时不给召回、地区疫苗规则等当前结论，只讲原则和该去核验的官方渠道。
skills.title_en: The cat advisor that will not hand you a dose
skills.tagline_en: Vomiting, litter-box protests, biting — the folk remedies circulating online make it worse. This runs an emergency red-flag pass first, then answers from AAFP/ISFM welfare guidance.
skills.why_en: The refusal is hard-coded: no doses, and it names the loopholes it will not accept — "my vet already told me", "it's just for an article", "convert it by weight".
skills.limit_en: The file bars every drug dose, frequency and course, and will not fill gaps even when the user says a vet gave instructions. It names Yunnan Baiyao, Huoxiang Zhengqi and smectite as home remedies it refuses. Cats only. Offline, it gives principles and the official channels to check rather than current recall or regional vaccine rules.

skills.name: noir-interrogation
skills.title_zh: 用 SHA-256 锁死凶手的黑色电影审讯游戏
skills.tagline_zh: 玩推理最怕 AI 中途被你说服改口。这个把答案的哈希公示在开场简报里，你一间间审嫌疑人，它只照脚本发的卡演。
skills.why_zh: 困难模式会塞进一个指错人的假证人，而扮演那个嫌疑人的模型自己也不知道那是假的。
skills.limit_zh: 一局 5–15 分钟，单场结束就完，不做多线战役。只有黑色电影一种类型，中途要奇幻或科幻会被拒绝；两套设定是 1940 年代美式与 1930 年代民国上海。作者明写不许 agent 去 Read 或 cat 案件 JSON，一旦绕过脚本，这个设计就作废了。
skills.title_en: A noir interrogation game that hashes the killer before you start
skills.tagline_en: What ruins AI mysteries is talking the model out of its own answer. Here the solution is SHA-256 committed in the opening briefing, and every suspect is played strictly off a card the script hands over.
skills.why_en: Hard mode plants a second witness who names the wrong person, and the model playing that suspect is not told the statement is false either.
skills.limit_en: One case runs 5–15 minutes and ends there; no campaigns. Noir only — fantasy or sci-fi requests are declined — in two settings, 1940s America and 1930s Shanghai. The file forbids the agent from ever reading or cat-ing the case JSON, since bypassing the script defeats the whole design.

skills.name: beachcombing
skills.title_zh: 把你必须几点前撤离滩涂顶在报告最前面的赶海参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 大潮那两小时能挖到什么、几点回头才不会被围住——它先算撤退时刻再谈收获，11 省 51 处点位带方言别名和吃法。
skills.why_zh: 最难得的是它给自己设了上限：走天文骨架估算时，适用性评分强制压到五档里的第二档，不假装精确。
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖中国大陆沿海，内置点库 11 省 51 处，其余靠 geocoding 兜底。没接真实潮汐 API 时走农历半日潮天文骨架，正文标「估算 ±1h」且评分不超过五档中的第二档。明确不做钓鱼预报、不做生物图像识别、不做休渔期与保护区的法律核对。
skills.title_en: The tide guide that leads with when you must be off the flats
skills.tagline_en: What is diggable in the two hours around a spring low tide, and when to turn back before the water closes in. Safe-exit time comes first, harvest second, across 51 sites in 11 coastal provinces.
skills.why_en: The rare part is the ceiling it puts on itself: when it falls back to an astronomical skeleton estimate, the suitability rating is capped at the second of five levels rather than faked.
skills.limit_en: Mainland Chinese coast only — 51 built-in sites across 11 provinces, everything else falls back to geocoding. Without a real tide API it computes a lunar semidiurnal skeleton, labelled "estimated ±1h" and capped at the second of five suitability levels. It explicitly declines fishing forecasts, species photo ID, and any legal check on closed seasons or protected areas.

skills.name: birdsight
skills.title_zh: 查稀有鸟最近落在哪，顺带说清中文名是台湾译名
skills.tagline_zh: 想知道这周末附近有没有稀有鸟、哪个热点在出货，它直连康奈尔 eBird 官方接口取真实观察记录，不靠模型记忆瞎编。
skills.why_zh: 20 个端点逐个实测过，还写明哪两个已经 404/403、别调；观测数据一律来自接口，不许凭训练知识补。
skills.limit_zh: 要自己去 ebird.org/api/keygen 申请免费 key，该 key 限非商业用途、并发超过 3 就 429。recent 端点最多回溯 30 天，全量历史得另申请 EBD。locale=zh 返回繁体台湾名（如「鉛色水鶇」），大陆常用名作者明说要自己维护别名表。
skills.title_en: Ask eBird who saw what bird, and where, this week
skills.tagline_en: Wondering whether anything rare has turned up near you this weekend, or which hotspot is producing — this queries Cornell's eBird API v2 directly for real sightings.
skills.why_en: All twenty endpoints were tested by hand, including the two that return 404 and 403 and are marked do-not-call. Sightings must come from the API, never from the model's memory.
skills.limit_en: You supply your own free key from ebird.org/api/keygen; free keys are non-commercial and start returning 429 above three concurrent requests. Recent-observation endpoints look back thirty days at most — full history needs a separate EBD request. Chinese common names come back in Taiwanese traditional form, and the author says to keep your own alias table rather than invent mainland ones.

skills.name: reading-pack
skills.title_zh: 把分级读物 PDF 里嵌的真人音频一页页抠出来
skills.tagline_zh: 孩子要读的分级读物是一堆 PDF，音频嵌在里面拿不出来。它按页抠图抠音、校对页码和音轨错位，一天打一个包传平板。
skills.why_zh: 它反过来劝你别加功能：纯图绘本不硬配音也不补文本，理由是亲子阅读本来就是大人念给孩子听。
skills.limit_zh: 产出的 .rdpkg 只有同仓库那个网页 App 能打开，家长端要能跑 uv 和 pymupdf。正文点名两个坑：RAZ 的页码与音频文件名会错位（错了孩子会听着 A 页的音读 B 页的字）；子集化 CJK 内嵌字体会把绘本正文渲染成空白。
skills.title_en: Pull the narration hidden inside graded-reader PDFs, page by page
skills.tagline_en: Your kid's graded readers are a pile of PDFs with the audio locked inside. This extracts page images and per-page narration, checks for page-to-audio drift, and packs one file per day for the tablet.
skills.why_en: It argues against features. Picture books with no audio get no synthetic narration and no filled-in text, because reading aloud to a child is the parent's job.
skills.limit_en: The .rdpkg it produces only opens in the small web app that ships in the same repo, and the parent side needs uv and pymupdf. The file names two traps: RAZ page numbers drift from audio filenames — get it wrong and the child hears page A while reading page B — and subset-embedded CJK fonts such as MPDFAA+HiraginoSansGBW3 render the body text as blank.

skills.name: recomp-coach
skills.title_zh: 卡路里跟克数打架就按克数重算的增肌减脂教练
skills.tagline_zh: 5:2 轻断食配碳水循环，难的不是方案是执行走样。它把每天的日志解析成 JSON，只点最大的那个缺口，只给一条调整。
skills.why_zh: 「一次只动一根杠杆」被写成硬规则：没有触发行就说「本周无需调整」，不为了显得有用而改方案。
skills.limit_zh: 作者自己在正文里写了外部效度短板：支撑间歇性限能的 MATADOR 与 Seimon 试验做的是肥胖人群，不是已经接近目标体脂的瘦人。方案假定健康成年人，周亏空必须落在 2000–4000 kcal；睡眠长期低于 7 小时时先标记睡眠，暂不调整饮食与训练。
skills.title_en: A recomp coach that recomputes your calories from the grams
skills.tagline_en: 5:2 fasting with carb cycling — the hard part was never the plan, it is the drift. It parses each daily log into JSON, names the single largest gap, and prescribes exactly one change.
skills.why_en: One lever at a time is a hard rule. With no trigger row met it says "hold, no change indicated" rather than adjusting something so it looks useful.
skills.limit_en: The author writes the external-validity gap into the file himself: the MATADOR and Seimon trials behind intermittent restriction were run in people with obesity, not lean people near target body fat. It assumes a healthy adult, keeps the weekly deficit in a 2,000–4,000 kcal band, and when sleep is chronically under seven hours it flags sleep first and holds all diet and training changes.

skills.name: heat-risk
skills.title_zh: 用湿球温度算出 48℃ 的吐鲁番比长沙安全
skills.tagline_zh: 「今天能不能跑步、军训、开工」，看气温会看错。它拉 open-meteo 七天预报算湿球温度，按五级直接给行动建议。
skills.why_zh: 换掉了大家惯用的那把尺子：31℃ 湿球以上一切户外都危险，35℃ 是理论生存极限（PNAS 2010）。
skills.limit_zh: 只给风险等级和建议，不做诊断——正文最后一条是出现高热无汗、意识模糊立即就医。中文城市名查不到时要改传拼音（作者举的例子是 Dunhuang）。数据源单一，只有 open-meteo 的 7 天预报，没有实测站点校正。
skills.title_en: Wet-bulb math that puts 48°C in Turpan below 35°C in Changsha
skills.tagline_en: Deciding whether it is safe to run, drill or work outside today — air temperature will mislead you. This pulls a seven-day open-meteo forecast, computes wet-bulb, and grades five risk levels.
skills.why_en: It swaps out the scale people actually use: above 31°C wet-bulb all outdoor activity is dangerous, and 35°C is the theoretical survival limit, cited to Sherwood & Huber, PNAS 2010.
skills.limit_en: It grades risk and stops there — the file's closing line sends anyone with high fever without sweating, or confusion, straight to a hospital. Chinese city names that miss have to be retyped in pinyin (the worked example is Dunhuang). One data source only: the open-meteo seven-day forecast, with no station correction.

skills.name: human-allegory-engine
skills.title_zh: 把模板清单撞碎后重写的荒诞超短篇
skills.tagline_zh: 模型写小小说总是同一套：领导宣布、众人执行、底层受苦、老人落泪。它把这些列成模板清单，撞上就强制换两个维度重写。
skills.why_zh: 拒绝模仿任何具体作家的文风，只把要求翻译成冷幽默、荒诞因果、留白这些可迁移技法；结尾掏磨损物件这类套路直接禁止。
skills.limit_zh: 只写中文超短篇，上限 3000 字。默认只输出标题和正文，不给寓意、落点、创作说明。不把真实个人或机构写成加害者，不用地域/职业/贫困/残障做快捷笑点，不为煽情临时加死亡与重病。
skills.title_en: Absurdist flash fiction that breaks its own templates
skills.tagline_en: Models write the same parable every time. This lists those beats as a checklist and forces two dimensions to change on collision.
skills.why_en: Refuses named-author mimicry; translates requests into transferable craft. The worn-object ending is on the ban list, not the title.
skills.limit_en: Chinese flash only, ≤3000 chars. Title + story only by default. No real persons/orgs as villains; no region/job/poverty/disability joke shortcuts; no late death for pathos.

skills.name: pollen-query
skills.title_zh: 花粉季出门前查一眼，53 城都有
skills.tagline_zh: 三四月对过敏的人是渡劫，而多数天气 app 根本不报花粉。它拉中国天气网的监测站数据，给浓度等级、风险提示和 7 天历史加预报。
skills.why_zh: 多数天气 app 不报花粉；它用标准库直拉监测站，缺数就明说，不把扩散指数冒充浓度。
skills.limit_zh: 仅 53 个有监测站的城市；淡季报无、单日缺口正常。备用源是扩散指数不是浓度，别当同一个数。仅中国大陆。
skills.tagline_en: Allergy season is an ordeal and most weather apps don't report pollen at all. It pulls monitoring-station data for grade, risk note, and seven days of history plus forecast.
skills.why_en: Standard library only, nothing to install; the fallback source is kept clearly separate from the primary one, and when data is missing it says so rather than passing off a dispersal index as a concentration.
skills.limit_en: Only the 53 cities with monitoring stations; smaller cities have no data. Out of season it reports none, and gaps on individual days are normal. The fallback gives a dispersal index, not a concentration — don't read them as the same number. Mainland China only.
skills.title_en: Check pollen before you go out, 53 cities

skills.name: parenting-advisor
skills.title_zh: 专防「假托崔玉涛」文章的 0–13 岁育儿参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 孩子发烧、咬人、不肯吃饭时，最怕搜到一篇署名权威的假文章。它逼自己每个结论凑够两个独立来源，凑不够就明说降可信度。
skills.why_zh: 它给自己列了一张「AI 可能说的借口」对照表——「症状太典型了基本能确定」在表里是必须叫停的信号。
skills.limit_zh: 档案默认写进 Obsidian 式知识库的固定路径（08-全局记忆/L1-画像记忆/孩子名），没有知识库得先指定一个本地目录。覆盖 0–13 岁，只说「症状被关联到 XX」不说「得了 XX」，不推荐任何药品和剂量；输入命中呼吸困难、抽搐等词会跳过全部流程，只输出就医引导。
skills.title_en: A 0–13 parenting advisor that will not take one source's word for it
skills.tagline_en: Fever, biting, refusing food — the real hazard is landing on a convincing article falsely bylined to a famous pediatrician. This forces two independent authoritative sources per conclusion, or downgrades its own confidence out loud.
skills.why_en: It keeps a table of the excuses an AI is likely to make. "The symptoms are textbook, I can basically confirm it" is listed there as a signal to stop, not to proceed.
skills.limit_en: Profiles are written to a fixed Obsidian-style vault path, so without a vault you must nominate a local directory first. Ages 0–13. It says "this symptom has been associated with X", never "your child has X", and recommends no drug or dose. Words like breathing difficulty or seizure skip every workflow and return only a go-to-hospital message.

skills.name: ian-xiaohei-illustrations
skills.title_zh: 给中文文章画手绘感解释图
skills.tagline_zh: 写完文章配图最头疼：截图太丑、AI 插画太飘。它专画流程、结构、隐喻——16:9 白底手绘，少量红橙蓝批注，一篇文章配下来像一个人画的。
skills.tagline_en: Ian-style illustrations for Chinese article bodies — 16:9 hand-drawn on white with sparse red-orange-blue annotations, built for processes, structures, metaphors and arguments.
skills.desc_en: 生成 Ian 风格的中文正文配图。用于用户要求为中文文章、帖子、博客、Notion 文档、工作流文档、方法论、流程、结构、状态、隐喻或观点生成“怪诞”“小黑”“手绘”“正文配图”“文章插图”“配图建议”“shot list”“去标题/改图”等任务；默认使用小黑 IP、纯白手绘、少量红橙蓝批注、简洁清爽但天马行空的视觉风格。
skills.why_zh: 「单一明确风格」的典范：不给你一堆选项，一种腔调做到底，所以全篇视觉统一。
skills.why_en: A model of committing to one look: no menu of options, one voice held all the way through, which is why a whole article stays visually coherent.
skills.limit_zh: 出图靠宿主内置的 image_gen，没这条能力就画不了。风格锁死 16:9、纯白底、小黑当主体，不给第二种选。图上中文批注由模型写，正文把错字严重列进重生成条件。
skills.limit_en: Rendering needs the host's built-in `image_gen`. The look is locked: 16:9, white ground, Xiaohei as the actor, no alternatives. The Chinese annotations are drawn by the model, and its QA list makes bad characters grounds for a re-roll.
skills.title_en: Article diagrams that look like one hand drew them

skills.name: deep-research
skills.title_zh: 把一个模糊主题做成深度调研报告
skills.tagline_zh: 想调研一个话题，AI 却给你一篇维基摘要？这套八步法逼它先拆问题再找料，产出的是能拿去做决策的报告，不是概述。
skills.tagline_en: Wang Shuyi's eight-step research methodology — turns a vague topic into a high-quality research report; "research this for me" triggers it.
skills.desc_en: 深度调研方法论（8步法）：将模糊主题转化为高质量调研报告。 触发词：/deep-research、深度调研、帮我调研、调研一下、对比分析 注意：如果用户需要的是可视化图谱而非报告，请使用 research-to-diagram skill。
skills.why_zh: 作者高校教师出身、常年教研究方法，这八步是真在带学生做研究时用的那套，不是拍脑袋编的流程。
skills.why_en: By a university teacher who has taught research method for years — these eight steps come from actually supervising research, not from a whiteboard.

install.note_zh: 两件不同的 skill 在 frontmatter 里都叫 deep-research —— 生态是扁平命名空间，同名就会互相静默覆盖。这里加了作者前缀消歧，跟作者仓库里的原名不一致是故意的。

skills.limit_zh: 产物写死在 ~/Downloads/research/<主题>/，打包成 ~/outcome.tar.gz。Step 6.5 硬卡：必须另起独立 Agent 复核事实与推导，派不出子代理就卡住。全程靠 WebSearch。
skills.limit_en: Working dir is hardcoded to ~/Downloads/research/<topic>/, packed into ~/outcome.tar.gz. Step 6.5 is BLOCKING: a separate Agent must audit the fact cards and reasoning, so no sub-agent means no report. Needs live WebSearch.
skills.title_en: The eight steps a research supervisor actually uses

skills.name: research-to-diagram
skills.title_zh: 调研完自动画成知识关系图 PDF
skills.tagline_zh: 研究做完还得画图讲给别人听——这步最烦。给它一个主题，它联网调研、整理、直接输出专业关系图谱 PDF，一步到位。
skills.tagline_en: Give it a topic: it researches online, organizes the findings, and outputs a professional knowledge-relationship diagram as PDF, end to end.
skills.desc_en: 深度调研主题并自动生成知识关系图谱PDF。接收研究主题后自动进行网络调研、信息收集、知识整理，最终生成专业的可视化关系图谱。适用于"研究...并做图"、"深度分析...并可视化"、"生成知识图谱"等场景。
skills.why_zh: 「调研完还得画图」是研究者的隐性负担，它把两步接成一步，产物是能放进正式文档的 PDF。
skills.why_en: Researchers quietly carry the burden of diagramming after research; this fuses both steps and ships a PDF you can put in a real document.
skills.limit_zh: 得本机装 Graphviz（正文只给 macOS 的 brew 装法），并依赖 Claude Code 内置 WebSearch。中文全靠 Arial Unicode MS 字体，缺了乱码。产物默认写到 ~/Downloads/。
skills.limit_en: Requires local Graphviz (the doc only gives the macOS brew line) and Claude Code's built-in WebSearch. Chinese labels depend on the Arial Unicode MS font or render as tofu. Caps at ~50 nodes per graph; writes to ~/Downloads/.
skills.title_en: Ends with the diagram everyone dreads drawing

skills.name: gc-minimal-zine-poster-v0-3
skills.title_zh: 把一句话变成极简杂志感海报
skills.tagline_zh: 想给文章配张有格调的图，AI 却总给你花里胡哨那种？它只做一件事：大留白、一处小拼贴、一个色彩重音，出的是编辑部的克制。
skills.tagline_en: Hand it a sentence, an article, a mood or a photo and get a paper-textured minimal zine poster — vast negative space, one small collage anchor, experimental typography, a single clear color accent.
skills.desc_en: Generate or analyze poetic paper-texture minimal zine posters with large negative space, a small editorial collage or visual anchor, experimental typography, and one clear color accent. Use when the user gives a theme, sentence, article, mood, object, photo, content brief, reference images, or an image folder and wants a final poster image, a production-ready image prompt, reusable style rules, or
skills.why_zh: 稀有在它卖「克制」——这是提示词最难稳定复现的高级感。带 evals 自测集，作者真在维护风格一致性。
skills.why_en: Rare in that what it sells is restraint — the hardest thing for a prompt to reproduce reliably. It ships an eval set, so the author is actually maintaining that consistency.
skills.limit_zh: 得有内置生图工具，靠 referenced_image_paths 或最多 5 张会话内图片传参。只出竖版留白纸感海报这一种形态；海报上的字必须短，长文案生图模型会写糊。保真失败只重生成一次，还不像就直说没做到。
skills.limit_en: Needs a built-in image tool, fed by referenced_image_paths or at most five in-session images. One form only: vertical, paper-textured, heavy negative space. Keep poster text short — image models garble long copy. On a fidelity miss it regenerates once, then says outright that it failed.
skills.title_en: Mostly empty posters, backed by an eval set

skills.name: interactive-map-builder
skills.title_zh: 把地点数据变成可交互的网页地图
skills.tagline_zh: 做旅行攻略、门店分布、活动路线，最后总卡在「怎么做一张能点的地图」。给它数据，它出一个能直接发的交互地图。
skills.tagline_en: Turn Excel coords into a searchable, filterable map—single HTML file, paper-ready SVG/PDF, even non-coders can.
skills.desc_en: Turn existing spatial or coordinate data into portable, browser-openable interactive map files and report-ready figures. Use when the user wants parcels, buildings, facilities, parking, roads, water, green space, projects, or Excel/CSV coordinates presented as a searchable, filterable, sortable map, map-and-list page, multilayer planning map, single-file HTML, slide image, or paper SVG/PDF—even wh
skills.why_zh: 输出是自包含网页而不是截图，能发能嵌；这类需求高频但少有现成解。
skills.why_en: Unlike static-only tools or server-dependent apps, it outputs a self-contained HTML with layers and filters—double-click to use.
skills.limit_zh: 只接已有坐标或几何：地理编码、缓冲叠加、路径规划、3D 一概不做，缺 CRS 直接失败、不替你猜。要先 pip 装它的 Python 包，每次调用先联网跑一次版本 preflight，自动分类配色最多 8 类。
skills.limit_en: Takes existing coordinates or geometry only: no geocoding, buffers, routing or 3D, and a missing CRS fails hard instead of being guessed. You pip-install its Python package, every run opens with an online update preflight.
skills.title_en: A spreadsheet of coordinates, out as one HTML map

skills.name: guizang-material-illustration
skills.title_zh: 生成有材质感的解释图和文章配图
skills.tagline_zh: 解释性配图最难两全：准确的往往丑，好看的往往说不清。歸藏这套专攻这一点——材质质感 + 文字标注，一眼看懂还挺好看。
skills.tagline_en: Generates Guizang-style material illustrations, labeled explanatory diagrams and chart beautification — the article visuals that are both instantly legible and good-looking.
skills.desc_en: Generate Guizang-style material illustrations, labeled explanatory visuals, material-styled chart illustrations, and data-first editorial images from articles, notes, product concepts, workplace reports, creator posts, tutorials, school materials, humanities topics, science explanations, screenshots, or chart data. Use when the user asks for 配图, 带字插图, 解释图, 图解插画, 概念拆解图, 图表美化, 数据图美化, 3D 图表, 汇报配图, 内容
skills.why_zh: 作者是中文 AI 设计内容的头部创作者，审美有背书——这类东西的价值全在挑图那双眼睛。
skills.why_en: The author is a leading Chinese voice on AI design; with work like this the value sits entirely in the eye doing the picking.
skills.limit_zh: 只做插图这一层：小红书/公众号卡片和 PPT 版式要另配社交卡片、PPT 两件 skill。要有 imagegen 或内置生图。图内标签压到 2-5 字，模型中文写不好就只能再删字。产物默认落在 local-tests/<slug>/。
skills.limit_en: The illustration layer only - card composition and slide layout go to the separate social-card and PPT skills. Needs imagegen or a built-in image tool. In-image labels cap at 2-5 Chinese characters. Output lands in local-tests/<slug>/.
skills.title_en: Explainer diagrams with texture you can almost feel

skills.name: qiaomu-learning
skills.title_zh: 用一问一答逼你自己想明白
skills.tagline_zh: AI 直接给答案，学的时候最爽、也最没用。丢一份教材、截图或一道题给它，它一次只问一个问题，带你自己推出来。
skills.tagline_en: Turns textbooks, screenshots, PDFs, notes or a single problem into a question-by-question derivation — one question at a time, making you reason it out instead of handing over answers.
skills.desc_en: 用苏格拉底式逐问学习把教材、截图、PDF、笔记、题目或一个主题变成主动推导对话。Use when the learner明确要求“苏格拉底式学习”“逐问带我学”“一次只问一个问题”“先别告诉我答案”“边问边引导我推出来”、interactive quiz、active recall or question-led tutoring。宽泛主题默认先进入关键词定向：列出 12 个关键词及白话解释，推荐专家和专业书籍，并提供“扩展关键词”的入口，再让学习者选起点。正式学习中每个活跃回合只问一个简短、可回答的问题，并根据学习者上一步的推理调整难度；回答要接住学习者原话，像真人老师一样温和纠错，并在数学、物理、流程或图形内容中用累积黑板逐步画出推理。学习者说“太抽象”“不理解”“想象不出来”“枯燥”或要求图解，且当前台阶可视觉化时，必须立即切换为问题承载型图示并提供文字替代，空间、相对运动、流程和几
skills.why_zh: AI 毁掉学习的最快方式就是给答案；「一次只问一个」这条硬约束正是解药。乔木出品。
skills.why_en: The fastest way AI ruins learning is handing over answers; the one-question-at-a-time constraint is exactly the antidote.
skills.limit_zh: 得你点名要苏格拉底式、一次一问才触发，你说「直接告诉我」它立刻退出。宽泛主题固定列 12 个关键词，写明是硬契约。配图靠 Codex 内置生图，没有就退回 ASCII 和坐标草图。
skills.limit_en: Only triggers when you explicitly ask for Socratic one-question-at-a-time tutoring, and exits the moment you say "just tell me". Broad topics always get exactly 12 keywords, a declared hard contract. Visuals need Codex image generation.
skills.title_en: The tutor that refuses to give you the answer

skills.name: unlazy
skills.title_zh: 逼 agent 干完重活别糊弄
skills.tagline_zh: 长任务做到一半开始偷懒、「差不多就这样吧」是通病。深度树把任务分层拆开，每层必须做完才准往上收。
skills.tagline_en: An anti-laziness discipline for substantial work — the Depth Tree method splits a task into layers, each of which must be finished before rolling up. No more "good enough, I guess".
skills.desc_en: Anti-laziness execution discipline for substantial tasks. Use when work keeps coming back half done, when an agent reports done before it is done, when output must be exhaustive rather than fast, on long autonomous runs that tend to stall at 80 percent, or on any invocation like /unlazy, "tree N", "gates", or "do not stop until it is done". v2 enforces completion through gate files and runnable ch
skills.why_zh: 把「分层且必须完成」变成硬纪律，比反复叮嘱它认真干有效得多。
skills.why_en: Agents start cutting corners mid-task; enforcing layered completion beats repeatedly telling them to try harder.
skills.limit_zh: 闸门校验要 Node 跑 scripts/gate-check.mjs；真把话说死的 Stop 钩子只在 Claude Code 有，还必须先问你才装。作者自己划线：闲聊、一行改动、半小时以内的活别用；编排模式要开得出子 agent。
skills.limit_en: Gate checks run node scripts/gate-check.mjs. The Stop hook that blocks an early finish is Claude Code only and must be offered, never installed silently. The author excludes chat, trivial edits and under-30-minute work.
skills.title_en: Stops the agent from settling for "good enough"

skills.name: moonlit-book-workflow
skills.title_zh: 给自家孩子做一本带家长配音的绘本
skills.tagline_zh: 孩子想听独属于他的故事。12 页英文绘本，固定水彩画风 + 角色设定图保证每页都是同一个小孩，再用你自己的声音朗读，出一个能直接发出去的文件。
skills.tagline_en: Makes a 12-page personalized English picture book for your kid — a fixed watercolor house style plus a per-book character sheet keeps the child looking like the same character across all pages, narrated in a parent's own cloned voice, shipped as one sendable HTML file.
skills.desc_en: Build or resume a reusable 12-page personalized English picture book in a fixed watercolor house style, with a per-book character sheet for illustration consistency and local authorized-adult voice cloning for narration.
skills.why_zh: 难点它都啃了：AI 插画最容易每页换个人，它用画风锚点+角色设定图锁死；声音只收成人授权音、监护人确认才继续，私密音频永不进成品。限 Apple Silicon + Codex，本地模型约 3.2G。
skills.why_en: It solves the hard parts: AI illustration usually drifts into a different-looking child each page, so it locks consistency with a style anchor plus a character sheet; voice cloning accepts only authorized adult recordings with guardian checkpoints, and private audio never ships in the output. Apple Silicon Mac + Codex only, ~3.2GB local model.
skills.limit_zh: 出的是英文绘本，中文得自己再转一道。要调生图模型和 TTS，成本随页数走；风格靠 style key 加角色设定图锁住，改任一项就得整本重生成。
skills.limit_en: It produces an English picture book — Chinese needs another pass. Costs scale with pages since it calls an image model and TTS; changing the style key or character sheet forces a full regeneration.
skills.title_en: A bedtime book read in your own cloned voice

skills.name: handdraw-good-deed-story
skills.title_zh: 批量做黑白线条逐笔显影的竖屏短片
skills.tagline_zh: 这种「线条一笔笔画出来」的短片在中文平台很吃香，难点是量产还不失手作感。35~45 秒一条，讲一个善行小故事。
skills.tagline_en: Batch-produces 35–45s vertical hand-drawn story shorts — black-line reveal animation telling a small good-deed tale, handmade feel at scale.
skills.desc_en: Batch-produce 35–45 second vertical hand-drawn good-deed story videos with black line art revealed left to right and aligned low-saturation color filling in the same direction. Use for Chinese warm-story shorts, gradual line-art coloring videos, reusable eight-beat story templates, or HyperFrames delivery of this visual format.
skills.why_zh: 它把这条产线固化了，批量出片仍保留手绘质感——这正是同类工具最容易丢掉的东西。
skills.why_en: Line-reveal shorts perform well on Chinese platforms; the trick is scaling without losing the handmade texture, and this pins that pipeline down.
skills.limit_zh: 线稿由 scripts/make_lineart.py 从彩图反推，成片靠 HyperFrames 和手拷进去的 gsap.min.js。每拍母图逐张生成，禁止自动重试。规格写死 720×960、8 拍 40 秒，BGM 你自己找授权。
skills.limit_en: Line art comes from scripts/make_lineart.py off the same color image; rendering needs HyperFrames plus gsap.min.js copied in from npm by hand. One mother image per beat, retries forbidden. Locked to 720x960, 8 beats, ~40s; BGM is on you.
skills.title_en: Vertical shorts drawn line by line, made in batches

skills.name: zhangxuefeng-perspective
skills.title_zh: 用张雪峰的框架分析升学和职业选择
skills.tagline_zh: 高考志愿、考研、转行——这类决定影响十年，家里人给的建议却常常凭感觉。它基于他 5 本书、15 篇深访提炼出的心智模型和决策启发式来拆。
skills.tagline_en: Analyzes education and career choices through Zhang Xuefeng's frameworks — five mental models and eight decision heuristics distilled from five books and 15+ interviews.
skills.desc_en: 张雪峰的思维框架与表达方式。基于5本著作、15+篇权威媒体深度采访、 30+条一手语录、11个关键决策记录和完整人生时间线的深度调研， 提炼5个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。 用途：作为思维顾问，用张雪峰的视角分析教育选择、职业规划、阶层流动等问题。 当用户提到「用张雪峰的视角」「张雪峰会怎么看」「张雪峰模式」「雪峰视角」时使用。 即使用户只是说「帮我用张雪峰的角度想想」「如果张雪峰会怎么说」「切换到张雪峰」也应触发。
skills.why_zh: 调研扎实，不是拿网红名字贴标签；请不到本人，就请一份他的思维方式。
skills.why_en: College and career decisions are high-stakes for Chinese families; if you can't hire him, hire his reasoning — and the research behind it is real, not name-dropping.
skills.limit_zh: 适用面它自己划得很死：普通家庭、就业导向的升学选择；家境宽裕、想走学术或创业的人，正文说这套建议可能反而是束缚。语料截至 2026-04-05，碰院校专业数据必须现搜。
skills.limit_en: It draws its boundary hard: ordinary families making employment-driven education choices. For well-off, academic or entrepreneurial paths it says the advice may become a constraint. Research ends 2026-04-05; school data is searched live.
skills.title_en: Eight decision rules from China's bluntest college counselor

skills.name: home-assistant-manager
skills.title_zh: 用对话管理智能家居的自动化配置
skills.tagline_zh: Home Assistant 的 YAML 改错一行，整屋自动化就哑掉。它带安全校验再部署，还能排查设备失联——终于不用手写配置了。
skills.tagline_en: Manage all of Home Assistant by conversation — safely edit automation YAML, deploy scripts and blueprints, debug offline devices. No more hand-written config.
skills.desc_en: Manage Home Assistant configuration safely and fast — edit and deploy YAML (automations, blueprints, scripts, scenes, templates, MQTT), validate with ha core check, deploy via git or rapid scp, reload-vs-restart correctly, verify changes from logs, traces and entity state, and build Lovelace dashboards. Use for any Home Assistant config, automation, template, or dashboard work over SSH/hass-cli/MC
skills.why_zh: 「校验后再部署」这个设计，是敢让 AI 碰真设备的前提。
skills.why_en: HA's YAML is the smart-home hobbyist's shared pain — one wrong line silences the house; this validates before deploying, so letting AI touch real devices is safe.
skills.limit_zh: 默认你有 SSH，且手上这个仓库就是 git 连着实例的 /config；改完还要 ssh 进去 git pull 才生效。hass-cli 的 HASS_TOKEN 得在会话启动前就设好，否则它会转向 localhost 报错。
skills.limit_en: Assumes SSH access and that the repo you edit is the HA /config dir wired to the instance by git; edits go live only after you ssh in and git pull. hass-cli needs HASS_TOKEN set before the session starts, or it hits localhost.
skills.title_en: Rewrites the YAML that can silence your whole house

skills.name: hyperframes-motion-director
skills.title_zh: 从一份提纲导出中文电影感短片
skills.tagline_zh: HyperFrames 官方件对中文排版水土不服：字挤、断行难看、字幕节奏不对。这件专治，中文优先重调了排版和镜头语言。
skills.tagline_en: A Chinese-first HyperFrames motion director — outline in, cinematic short out, with typography, caption rhythm and camera language tuned for Chinese content.
skills.desc_en: Direct and produce Chinese-first cinematic motion videos with HyperFrames. Use this skill when the user wants a rendered promo film, article-to-video piece, product launch film, website-to-video piece, keynote reveal, kinetic typography sequence, text/icon transition promo, music-synced motion graphic, HTML/CSS/SVG/GSAP video, short-form vertical video, or a landing page/product story turned into
skills.why_zh: 作者是 md2wechat 那位（已在架的中文精品作者），补的正是官方件在中文场景的短板。
skills.why_en: By the author of md2wechat (already on our shelves) — the official skills stumble on Chinese typography; this one fixes exactly that.
skills.limit_zh: 要本机的 HyperFrames CLI 和 Node 脚本，配图走 Codex Image Gen，终版渲染要 Docker。第一阶段只交一份提案就停，你不点头它不动工；默认只出 10-15 秒竖屏 1080x1920。
skills.limit_en: Needs a local HyperFrames CLI, Node scripts, Codex Image Gen for stills, Docker for the final render. Phase 1 stops at a written proposal until you confirm. Defaults to 10-15s vertical 1080x1920.
skills.title_en: Fixes the Chinese typography the official tools break

skills.name: human-writing
skills.title_zh: 让中文读起来像一个具体的人在说话
skills.tagline_zh: AI 写的中文一眼能认出来：套话、排比、什么都对但没人味。它不做关键词黑名单，而是立一个「见过事、查过料」的人的口吻。
skills.tagline_en: Makes Chinese read like a person who has seen things, checked sources and wants to explain properly — long answers, articles, scripts and dialogue alike.
skills.desc_en: 通用中文创作与改稿 Skill。用于知乎回答、论坛长帖、公众号文章、博客、评论、人物故事、历史叙事、新闻与行业解读、科普、教程、评测、个人叙事、小说、故事、对白、口播和演讲稿。默认写成一个见过事、查过材料、愿意把来龙去脉讲清楚的人在说话，重点保留中文互联网长回答与长帖的活人感和自然中文韵律，避免空泛的机构腔、喊口号式演说腔、营销腔和模型腔。非虚构长文先检查材料够不够，材料不足时研究、追问或缩短，绝不用重复解释灌字数。现实内容额外核验事实、引语、数据与用户亲历，虚构内容可以创造人物、场景、对白、心理与情节。成稿正文严禁冒号、破折号、“不是……而是……”及同类翻案句，并清除商业黑话和模型惯用黑话。不创建作者画像、个人规则库或个人写作 Skill。
skills.why_zh: 立人设比删 AI 词高一档——前者管句式和视角，后者只换词。中文原创，不是译过来的。
skills.why_en: Installing a specific human voice beats blacklisting AI words — the first governs syntax and point of view, the second only swaps vocabulary. Chinese original, not a translation.
skills.limit_zh: 非虚构材料列不满五件就不给你写长稿，最多交六百字。破折号、提示性冒号、「不是A而是B」这类句式一概封死，风格上没得商量。check_prose.py 只查已写明的硬禁项。
skills.limit_en: If a nonfiction piece cannot list five concrete pieces of material, it refuses to write long and caps you near 600 characters. Em dashes, signposting colons and "not A but B" framing are banned. check_prose.py checks hard bans only.
skills.title_en: Installs a voice instead of banning AI words

skills.name: qiaomu-cut
skills.title_zh: 做可复现可验收的视频剪辑工程
skills.tagline_zh: AI 剪的视频改一版就得重新抽卡，交付时也说不清素材哪来的。它做素材治理、双语字幕、品牌包装，每步留痕，重跑结果不变。
skills.tagline_en: Turns a one-line brief into a reproducible, reviewable video project — governed sourcing, bilingual subtitles, brand packaging and traceable renders.
skills.desc_en: 把一句话需求转成可复现、可验收视频工程的乔木智能剪辑导演。Use when the user asks to create, plan, edit, remix, explain, narrate, subtitle, animate, composite, or render a video; build English-learning movie mixes, person profiles, explainers, product launch videos, cinematic shorts, social clips, course/PPT videos, AI image/video/TTS/music-assisted stories, stock-footage stories, or multi-source montage. Routes across 33台词, C
skills.why_zh: 「可复现 + 可验收」在 AI 视频里很少见：改一版不用碰运气，交付时每一帧都有出处。
skills.why_en: Reproducible and reviewable are rare words in AI video — revisions don't re-roll the dice, and you can account for every frame.
skills.limit_zh: 渲染要 ffmpeg-full，随附的安装脚本只写了 macOS 和 Homebrew。台词库与 ListenHub 各要自己单独装的 CLI，还会耗积分。片尾硬性带「向阳乔木」和 @vista8，规则里不许省。
skills.limit_en: Rendering needs ffmpeg-full and the bundled bootstrap script is Homebrew/macOS only. The movie-line search and ListenHub each need their own separately installed CLI and burn credits. Every outro must carry the author's name and @vista8.
skills.title_en: Video edits that don't re-roll the dice

skills.name: guizang-ppt-skill
skills.title_zh: 做能双屏演讲的网页版 PPT
skills.tagline_zh: 上台讲的时候最想要演讲者视图和观众屏同步，普通 AI 做的 PPT 一概没有。它出的是单文件网页 deck，带 WebGL 流体背景和章节幕封。
skills.tagline_en: Single-file web decks with WebGL fluid backgrounds, presenter view, audience-screen sync and chapter covers — in editorial-magazine or Swiss-international styles.
skills.desc_en: 生成横向翻页网页 PPT（单 HTML 文件），含 WebGL 背景、演讲者视图、观众屏同步、讲稿备注、章节幕封、数据大字报、图片网格等模板。提供两种风格：① "电子杂志 × 电子墨水"（衬线 + 流体背景 + 暖色） ② "瑞士国际主义"（无衬线 + 网格点阵 + IKB/柠檬黄/柠檬绿/安全橙高亮）。当用户需要制作分享 / 演讲 / 发布会风格的网页 PPT，或提到"杂志风 PPT"、"瑞士风 PPT"、"Swiss Style"、"horizontal swipe deck"时使用。
skills.why_zh: 演讲者视图和双屏同步这种细节，市面上的 AI PPT 工具基本没人做，歸藏把它塞进了一个 HTML。
skills.why_en: Presenter view and second-screen sync are details almost no AI deck tool bothers with, and this one folds them into a single HTML file.
skills.limit_zh: 作者自己划的禁区：大段表格图表、培训课件、多人协作编辑都别用它，成品就是一份静态 HTML。主题只能从预设 5 套/4 套里挑，不收自定义 hex；两套风格类名互斥不能混。校验脚本要 Node，渲染实测还要 Playwright。
skills.limit_en: The author rules out dense tables, courseware and collaborative editing - the artifact is one static HTML file. Themes come from the 5 or 4 presets, no custom hex, and the two styles' class names cannot be mixed. Validators need Node.
skills.title_en: Presenter view and dual screens, in one file

skills.name: excalidraw-diagram
skills.title_zh: 生成手绘白板风格的示意图
skills.tagline_zh: 讲思路时精确框图显得冷，手绘草图更让人愿意看。它出真正的 Excalidraw 文件，画完你还能自己拖着改。
skills.tagline_en: Generates Excalidraw hand-drawn diagram JSON for workflows, architectures and concepts — that whiteboard-sketch warmth, still editable on import.
skills.desc_en: Create Excalidraw diagram JSON files that make visual arguments. Use when the user wants to visualize workflows, architectures, or concepts.
skills.why_zh: 产物是可编辑源文件而不是截图——这一点决定了它能进日常工作流，而不只是配图。
skills.why_en: Hand-drawn beats rigid boxes for explaining ideas warmly; real Excalidraw files you keep editing after.
skills.limit_zh: 必做的渲染校验要用 uv 装 Playwright 和 Chromium。正文禁止写脚本生成、禁止转交别的 agent，只能一段段手敲 JSON，再渲染—看图—改，通常来回 2-4 轮。 随件的渲染模板从 esm.sh 拉 excalidraw，传递依赖现在 404、脚本会等到超时；钉版本到 0.18.0 才渲得出来。
skills.limit_en: The mandatory validation step renders through uv, Playwright and Chromium. The skill forbids writing a generator script or handing the job to a coding agent: you hand-write JSON section by section, then loop render-view-fix 2-4 times. Its render template pulls excalidraw from esm.sh; a transitive dependency 404s today and the script hangs until timeout. Pinning 0.18.0 fixes it.
skills.title_en: Generated diagrams that look hand-drawn and stay editable
skills.cover_note: 命令：`git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/coleam00/excalidraw-diagram-skill; python -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install playwright && venv/bin/playwright install chromium; 【必须打一处补丁】r`。我造的 demo（图的内容我自己写：Agent Skill 的渐进式披露加载流程，四步 + 一段真实 frontmatter + 一条提醒）

skills.name: punk-ip-article-illustrations
skills.title_zh: 生成专属你的 IP 角色并贯穿每篇文章
skills.tagline_zh: 文章配图每篇风格都不一样，读者记不住你。上传一张照片生成专属 IP 角色（含四视图设定板），之后每篇都是同一个「你」在演。
skills.tagline_en: Upload one photo to mint your own IP character (with a four-view sheet), then send that character into every article you write — retro flat-3D vignette style, image count auto-scaled to article length.
skills.desc_en: Punk 出品的完整个人 IP 插图工作流：从用户上传的人物照片创建、修订、确认并持久化可复用角色，也可直接启用内置 Punk 角色；角色确认后读取完整文章、Markdown、网页、帖子或观点，自动决定数量并生成复古彩色扁平 3D 小剧场正文插图。适用于创建个人 IP、角色设定板、切换角色、文章自动配图、长文多图、流程拆解图和核心动作图等连续任务。
skills.why_zh: 戳中自媒体的辨识度护城河：不是又一个文章配图，而是先立住视觉人格再篇篇复用。照片不上传、不推断敏感属性。
skills.why_en: Nails a real creator pain — not another article-illustrator, but a way to establish your own visual persona first, then reuse it across every piece. One consistent "you" running through all your content is a recognition moat. Photos stay local; no sensitive-attribute inference.
skills.limit_zh: 角色要你亲口说「确认」才解锁配图，draft 状态不许激活，给了文章也不提前画。宿主没有生图能力时它只交提示词和保存计划，不出图。角色包只存本地运行目录。
skills.limit_en: The character stays locked until you explicitly confirm it — drafts can't be activated, and handing it an article won't skip that gate. With no image tool on the host it returns prompts instead of pictures. Character packs stay local only.
skills.title_en: One photo, then that character appears in every article

skills.name: dnd
skills.title_zh: 一个人也能玩的 D&D 地下城主
skills.tagline_zh: 跑团最难的是凑人和一个好 DM。它管战役、角色卡、战斗轮次和 NPC，还带可选的影院式画面，一个人也能沉浸开团。
skills.tagline_en: An on-call D&D 5e Dungeon Master — persistent campaigns, character sheets, combat tracking and NPCs, with an optional cinematic display. Solo-play ready.
skills.desc_en: v2.4.0 · Dungeon Master assistant for running persistent D&D 5e campaigns. Handles campaign creation/loading, character management, combat tracking, NPC generation, dice rolling, and session state — all persisted across sessions. Invoke with /dm:dnd followed by a subcommand, or just speak naturally once a campaign is loaded.
skills.why_zh: 它补上的是 DM 这个最难替代的位置，规则和状态全托管，所以单人玩不塌。
skills.why_en: The hard part of tabletop is a good DM and a full table; this fills the DM seat — rules, campaign and NPCs managed for solo immersion.
skills.limit_zh: 战役数据全在本机 ~/.claude/dnd，换台机器就从零开。随包只有 5e SRD 数据集，跑正式模组得你自己导入书。影院画面是本地/局域网起的 Flask 面板。默认 roll_mode 是玩家自己掷骰，它不替你的 PC 代掷。
skills.limit_en: Campaign data lives locally under ~/.claude/dnd - a new machine starts empty. Only the 5e SRD dataset ships; published modules you import yourself. The cinematic display is a local/LAN Flask app. Default roll_mode never auto-rolls your PC.
skills.title_en: A dungeon master for a table of one

skills.name: diagram
skills.title_zh: 自动选对图表类型再画出来
skills.tagline_zh: 多数人卡在「该用泳道图还是时序图」，不是不会画。它先按需求选型，再从 29 种里出符合规范的 PNG。
skills.tagline_en: Picks the right chart type for your need and renders it — 29 kinds including swimlanes, sequence, ER, Gantt, Kanban and Git graphs, straight to spec-compliant PNG.
skills.desc_en: 专业图表生成技能：根据需求自动选择合适的图表类型，生成符合设计规范的 PNG 图表。 覆盖 29 种图表：结构图（流程图、泳道图、时序图、架构图、状态图、ER图、类图、思维导图、甘特图、Kanban、Git Graph 等） 和统计图（柱状图、折线图、饼图、雷达图、热力图、散点图、桑基图、漏斗图、瀑布图、矩形树图、柱线混合图等）。 统一工具：HTML/SVG + 内联 JS 布局计算。ER/类图使用 ELKjs 布局引擎。 所有图表遵循统一的设计规范（配色/字体/组件/间距），风格现代简洁。 支持三种输出：PNG（默认）、HTML（富文档嵌入）、DSL（Mermaid 文本，嵌入 MD 文档）。 触发词：画图、画一个、生成图表、流程图、架构图、时序图、柱状图、对比图、关系图。 即使用户没有说"画图"，只要需求中涉及可视化展示（流程、架构、数据对比、关系），都应触发此技能。 被 deep-r
skills.why_zh: 先选型后出图这个顺序，比丢给你一堆模板实用得多。
skills.why_en: Most people stall on which chart, not how to draw it; choosing the type before rendering is more useful than handing over templates.
skills.limit_zh: 出 PNG 必须跑 scripts/capture.py 和 bridge.py（内部调 Playwright），正文禁止你手动截图。雷达、热力、散点、漏斗、瀑布不支持 Mermaid 文本输出，只能留 PNG。
skills.limit_en: PNGs only come out of scripts/capture.py and bridge.py, which drive Playwright internally — screenshotting by hand is forbidden. Radar, heatmap, scatter, funnel and waterfall get no Mermaid text output, only PNG.
skills.title_en: Decides which of 29 diagram types you actually meant

skills.name: claude-to-im
skills.title_zh: 从手机指挥电脑里跑着的 agent
skills.tagline_zh: 长任务要跑一小时，你却得出门。把会话桥到 Telegram、飞书、微信，手机上发一句就能远程派活，干完还推给你。
skills.tagline_en: Bridges your live agent session to Telegram, Discord, Feishu, QQ or WeChat — command the Claude running on your computer straight from your phone.
skills.desc_en: Bridge THIS Claude Code or Codex session to Telegram, Discord, Feishu/Lark, QQ, or WeChat so the user can chat with Claude from their phone. Use for: setting up, starting, stopping, or diagnosing the claude-to-im bridge daemon; forwarding Claude replies to a messaging app; any phrase like "claude-to-im", "bridge", "消息推送", "消息转发", "桥接", "连上飞书", "手机上看claude", "启动后台服务", "诊断", "查看日志", "配置". Subcommand
skills.why_zh: 歸藏出品，解决的是真痛点：agent 的时间和人的时间从此不用绑在一起。
skills.why_en: By Guizang — solves the real pain of long tasks while you're away; command remotely from your phone, get pinged when done.
skills.limit_zh: 本机得一直开着：桥是常驻 Node 进程，装完还要在 skill 目录 npm install 和 build。微信只能扫码绑一个号，没有内联授权按钮和流式预览，语音只收微信自己转的文字。飞书要两轮发版加管理员审批。
skills.limit_en: Your machine must stay up: the bridge is a resident Node daemon, and its dir needs npm install plus build. WeChat is QR-login, one account only, no inline permission buttons or streaming, voice only via WeChat's own transcript.
skills.title_en: Runs on your desk, takes orders from your phone

skills.name: aso-appstore-screenshots
skills.title_zh: 从代码反推卖点生成 App Store 截图
skills.tagline_zh: 独立开发者最不擅长又最影响下载量的就是商店截图。它先读你的代码库找出核心卖点，再生成 ASO 优化的展示图。
skills.tagline_en: Analyzes your app's codebase to surface core benefits, then generates ASO-optimized App Store screenshots — the download page that actually converts.
skills.desc_en: Generate high-converting App Store screenshots by analyzing your app's codebase, discovering core benefits, and creating ASO-optimized screenshot images using Nano Banana Pro.
skills.why_zh: 从代码反推卖点，比对着空白页想文案聪明——素材来自产品本身而不是想象。
skills.why_en: Store screenshots are what indies do worst and download rates need most; deriving benefits from code beats guessing at copy.
skills.limit_zh: 检测不到 Gemini MCP（npm i -g gemini-mcp）它就直接停手不生成；裁切那步调的是 macOS 专有的 sips。尺寸只给 iPhone 6.5/6.7/6.9 三种，没有 iPad，模拟器截图还得你自己拍。 compose.py 把字体写死成 /Library/Fonts/SF-Pro-Display-Black.otf，macOS 不自带、缺了直接崩没兜底；第二段还要付费模型。
skills.limit_en: It refuses to generate unless the Gemini MCP server (npm i -g gemini-mcp) is present, and the crop/resize step shells out to macOS-only sips. Ships iPhone 6.5/6.7/6.9 sizes only, no iPad — and you supply the simulator screenshots yourself. compose.py hardcodes an SF Pro font path macOS does not ship; it crashes with no fallback. Stage 2 also needs a paid model.
skills.title_en: Reads your source code to write App Store screenshots

skills.name: translate-book
skills.title_zh: 把整本书翻译成任何语言
skills.tagline_zh: 一本书几十万字，串行翻要等到天荒地老。它用并行子 agent 分块同时翻，保留原书排版，输出 HTML/DOCX/EPUB。
skills.tagline_en: Translates whole PDF/DOCX/EPUB books into any language — parallel sub-agents chunk and translate at once, layout preserved, multi-format out.
skills.desc_en: Translate books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel sub-agents. Converts input -> Markdown chunks -> translated chunks -> HTML/DOCX/EPUB/PDF.
skills.why_zh: 并行是关键：把几小时压到几十分钟，而且排版不散——这才让「翻整本书」从设想变成可做的事。
skills.why_en: Parallel sub-agents are the trick — serial translation of a whole book takes forever; chunked parallelism cuts hours to minutes, layout intact.
skills.limit_zh: 本机要有 python3 和 pandoc，DOCX/EPUB/PDF 还得装 Calibre，缺了只剩 HTML。默认放 8 个子 agent 并发，整本书的 token 你自己付；术语表只从 5 个抽样块里提。
skills.limit_en: Needs python3 and pandoc locally; DOCX/EPUB/PDF conversions require Calibre, otherwise you only get HTML. Default 8 parallel sub-agents, so the whole book is billed as tokens, and the glossary is extracted from only 5 sampled chunks.
skills.title_en: Translates a whole book in parallel, layout intact

skills.name: math-modeling
skills.title_zh: 三天赛程里做完数学建模竞赛全流程
skills.tagline_zh: 建模竞赛最难的是三天内同时搞定建模、编程、写论文。它按三阶段分工推进，每阶段还有独立质检 subagent 把关。
skills.tagline_en: A full-pipeline assistant for math-modeling contests — modeling, solving in code, visualization and paper writing, with an independent QA subagent per stage.
skills.desc_en: 当用户要求数学建模、建模竞赛、建模分析、代码求解、结果可视化或生成数学建模论文时使用。支持完整三阶段流程、单独执行任一角色，以及在关键节点使用独立 Subagent 进行阶段内质检；默认只启用质检 Subagent，用户可明确选择额外协作。
skills.why_zh: 按竞赛真实节奏设计的，不是把「数学建模」当学科名词做个通用助手。
skills.why_en: Contest pain is doing modeling, coding and writing in three days; this splits the roles and adds QA gates — designed to the real contest rhythm.
skills.limit_zh: 作者自己写明产出的论文不能直接当作品交，格式还得对当届官方模板。运行环境派不出 Subagent 时，M1/P1/P2/W1/W2 五道门禁只能标 BLOCKED；LaTeX 分支缺编译引擎会直接阻塞。
skills.limit_en: The author states the paper is not a directly submittable entry, and formatting must follow the current year's official template. Without Subagents the M1/P1/P2/W1/W2 gates can only be marked BLOCKED; LaTeX blocks without a compiler.
skills.title_en: A three-day contest team with its own QA critic

skills.name: punk-cover
skills.title_zh: 把文章一句话变成封面图
skills.tagline_zh: 每篇文章都要封面，找图配字最耗时。11 种精调风格（商业杂志头版、复古手撕拼贴、巨型透视中文标题…），每种都标了适合什么内容。
skills.tagline_en: Turn any article, note or tweet into a cover image in one line — 11 finely tuned styles (magazine front page, torn-paper collage, giant Chinese title…) for Xiaohongshu, WeChat and X.
skills.desc_en: Generate cover images and reusable image prompts from the shared Punk style library for articles, Xiaohongshu notes, WeChat public account posts, X posts, topic drafts, and requests for covers, social cover images, poster prompts, style-template-based image prompts, or image generation from long-form text. Use this skill to analyze source content, confirm platform/aspect ratio and visual style, sa
skills.why_zh: 风格库真下过功夫：选风格像点菜一样准，出的封面有编辑部气质而不是 AI 糊图。
skills.why_en: The style library is genuinely crafted — each one tagged with what content it fits, so picking feels like ordering off a menu; covers land with editorial polish, not AI mush.
skills.limit_zh: 没告诉它平台和风格，它就停在提问那一步，不会先出一版给你看。预置比例只有小红书 3:4、公众号 2.35:1、X 5:2；一次一张、不给多版对比，也不许两种风格混用。

skills.title_en: Eleven cover styles, ordered off a menu

skills.name: positioning-and-story
skills.title_zh: 把产品叙事改写成开发者当英雄的故事
skills.tagline_zh: 文案听起来像在介绍功能而不是解决痛点，转化就上不去。它重写成「开发者是英雄、某个真实趋势是反派」的结构。
skills.tagline_en: Rewrites your product narrative into a story where the developer is the hero and a real trend is the villain — reach for it when your copy describes the product instead of the pain.
skills.desc_en: Build a positioning and narrative where the developer is the hero and a real trend is the villain. Use when the messaging describes the product instead of the problem, sounds like every competitor, or has no urgency because nothing is at stake.
skills.why_zh: 英雄 vs 反派这个框架把干巴巴的功能列表变成有代入感的故事——技术人最不擅长、又最影响转化的一环。
skills.why_en: The hero-vs-villain frame turns a dry feature list into a story people enter — the piece technical folks are worst at and that most moves conversion.
skills.limit_zh: 整份反派清单和例子都长在开发者工具语境里（构建慢、YAML 泛滥、云成本、流水线不稳），面向非开发者的产品套不上。它两次把你转去同仓库的 talk-to-users，那件不在包里。
skills.limit_en: Every villain and example lives in dev-tool land — slow builds, YAML sprawl, cloud-cost sprawl, flaky pipelines — so it won't transfer to a non-developer audience. Twice it hands you to a sibling talk-to-users skill that isn't bundled.
skills.title_en: Gives your product story a hero and a villain

skills.name: design-review
skills.title_zh: 给 Go 代码库做地道性评审
skills.tagline_zh: Go 里「能跑」和「地道」差得远。命名、结构、一致性、接口、错误处理逐维打分，还附可执行的修法。
skills.tagline_en: Deep design review for Go codebases — naming, structure, consistency, interfaces and error handling scored, with fixes.
skills.desc_en: Deep design review of Go codebase — naming, structure, consistency, interfaces, error handling. Scores each dimension and provides actionable fixes.
skills.why_zh: 按维度打分让评审意见特别可落地，不是笼统说「建议重构」。
skills.why_en: In Go, "works" and "idiomatic" are far apart; per-dimension scoring makes the feedback actionable.
skills.limit_zh: 正文明说单个 PR 或未提交 diff 不归它管，那要另一件 code-review。而且末尾嵌着 pi-go 这个项目自己的检查项（ADK、internal/provider/、禁 init()），换仓库得先删。
skills.limit_en: The text excludes single PRs and uncommitted diffs (it points you to a separate code-review skill). It also carries a hardcoded "Project-Specific Checks (pi-go)" block - ADK, internal/provider/, no init() - other repos must strip.
skills.title_en: Scores your Go on idiomatic, not on working

skills.name: writing-agent

skills.tagline_en: A full-stack Chinese writing system on Claude Code that strips AI-flavor — forces human viewpoint and detail, with reader-test evals and auto layout, from topic to publish.

skills.why_zh: 国产模型友好（DeepSeek/GLM/MiniMax），把「防 AI 味」从口号做成了强制规则——中文写作全家桶里立意很高的一套。
skills.why_en: Friendly to domestic models and turning de-AI-flavor from slogan into enforced rules — a high-ambition Chinese writing suite.

skills.name: story-cover

skills.title_en: Explainer videos in Vox's paper-collage style

Use when the user asks to turn a frontend project or webpage into a product video, says "use video-shotcraft to make a video/promo", names the Ink Press template or asks to reproduce its effect, or wants a sing

skills.limit_en: Needs a Remotion project and npm; real-page shots require a local dev server plus headless-browser capture. Jianying export runs on pyJianYingDraft: the Mac path was tested against Jianying 11.2, the Windows one never was.
skills.title_en: Product films built from 106 shot recipes

skills.name: ecommerce-visual-copywriting
skills.title_zh: 先判断什么带来转化，再出电商主图的分镜和文案
skills.tagline_zh: 电商主图与详情页的视觉策划 SOP：先判断转化驱动力锁定风格，再出分镜、图内文案和生图 Prompt。
skills.tagline_en: An e-commerce visual SOP — diagnose the conversion driver, lock the campaign style, then storyboard, on-image copy and prompts.
skills.desc_en: 电商主图与详情页视觉策划 Skill。根据产品资料、资质边界、目标平台和视觉参考，先判断转化驱动力并锁定 Campaign Style Lock，再输出主图/详情页 Storyboard；用户确认后，交付画面描述、图内文案、设计说明和生图 Prompt。 适用于淘宝、天猫、京东、拼多多、抖音小店等平台的商品主图、详情页、listing、商品卖点、视觉脚本、合规改写和广告法风险审查。 触发词包括：主图文案、详情页文案、电商视觉策划、卖点提炼、视觉脚本、转化率、点击率、合规审查、广告法、平台审核、设计师执行稿。 不用于最终法律意见、医疗或保健功效背书、自动上架发布、编造检测报告/专利/批准文号/销量/评价，或和电商视觉落图无关的普通营销长文。
skills.why_zh: 「设计小白做出五年资深的商品图」不是吹牛，SOP 把资深设计师的判断顺序写死了。
skills.why_en: The senior-designer-in-a-box claim holds because the SOP hard-codes a senior's decision order.
skills.limit_zh: 它只交画面描述、图内文案和生图 Prompt，图得你另找工具生成。策划案和 Storyboard 两道门必须你回话才继续。资质、检测、销量缺了就标缺失，它不补也不出法律结论。
skills.limit_en: It delivers scene descriptions, in-image copy and image-generation prompts - you still need a separate tool to render anything. Two gates (plan, then storyboard) pause for your reply; missing certifications, test reports or sales figures are flagged, never invented, and it draws no legal conclusions.
skills.title_en: Works out what converts before designing the image

skills.name: caveman
skills.title_zh: 让 Claude 用原始人腔说话，据称省下 65% 的 token
skills.tagline_zh: 让 Claude 像原始人一样说话：「为什么用很多 token，少 token 就行」——据称实测省 65% token，还越用越上头。
skills.tagline_en: Claude talks caveman — "why use many token when few token do trick." Claimed 65% token savings in practice, and weirdly addictive.
skills.desc_en: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is reques
skills.why_zh: 一个玩笑做成了真产品：token 账单实打实地降（据称 65%），还顺手治好了 AI 的啰嗦病。
skills.why_en: A joke that became a product — real token savings (claimed 65%), and it cures verbosity as a side effect.
skills.limit_zh: 65% 是作者自己标注的实测，正文没给测法。凡是写到聊天之外的字——代码注释、commit、文档、issue、记忆文件——一律恢复正常散文，那部分省不到。安全警告也自动切回。

skills.title_en: Claude speaks caveman, your token bill drops

skills.name: design-harness
skills.title_zh: 喂它论文和半成形想法，产出一份你能答辩的系统设计
skills.tagline_zh: 喂它论文和半成形想法，它连成一套你能答辩的系统设计：来源→观点→产出三层，全程 Markdown 留痕。
skills.tagline_en: Feed it papers and half-formed ideas; it links them into a defensible system design — sources, ideas, output, all on record.
skills.desc_en: A decision board for evidence-based calls — the human adjudicates, the agent runs the errands. Three layers (sources → ideas → output) in plain markdown, synced on the human's command, projected onto a visual canvas. Use for vendor/tool selection, literature reviews, due diligence, competitive analysis, or any contested call that must stand on traceable evidence — triggers like "file these papers"
skills.why_zh: 「人拍板、agent 跑腿」的分工设计得很清醒，证据链留痕让结论真能答辩。
skills.why_en: Human adjudicates, agent runs errands — and the evidence trail makes conclusions actually defensible.
skills.limit_zh: 它一条判断都不替你下：想法要你先说出口才转写成卡，output 只在你下令时才动。建图全靠 python3 脚本，两个校验器不过就一张 HTML 都不出。输出形态目前只有 system-design 一种。

skills.title_en: Turns papers and half-ideas into a defensible design

skills.title_en: Your PNG logo, vectorized, animated, and QA'd

skills.name: bazi-ziwei
